jobs.description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.

We are looking for a Senior HPC and AI Network Software Architect to help build the next generation of scalable AI infrastructure. The role emphasizes distributed training, real-time inference, and communication efficiency across large systems. You will develop new software and hardware approaches, shape platform evolution through hands-on innovation, and contribute to designing systems powering the fastest AI workloads globally. Collaborate with our distinguished team of researchers and engineers building software and hardware for AI at an outstanding scale.

What you will be doing:

• Build and evolve the architecture of scalable software systems for distributed AI training and inference, focusing on throughput, latency, resiliency, and memory efficiency across cluster-scale deployments.

• Develop and evaluate next-generation communication and runtime capabilities in libraries such as NCCL, UCX, and UCC, tailored to the evolving demands of frontier AI workloads.

• Partner with AI framework teams (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, JAX) and internal platform teams to build integrations, explore new approaches, and improve end-to-end performance and reliability.

• Collaborate on hardware and system-level features across GPUs, DPUs, and interconnects to speed up data movement and enable new capabilities for training, inference, and model serving at scale.

• Drive innovation across runtime systems, communication libraries, and AI-specific protocol layers, helping turn new ideas into practical capabilities and robust implementations.

What we need to see:

• Ph.D., or equivalent industry experience, in computer science, computer engineering, or a closely related field.

• 5+ years of experience in systems programming, parallel or distributed computing, high-performance networking, or large-scale data movement, including experience designing and building complex systems.

• Strong programming background in C++, Python, and ideally CUDA or other GPU programming models, with a track record of building production-quality performance-critical software.

• Extensive hands-on experience with AI frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX) and a solid grasp of how communication libraries and runtime systems facilitate large-scale training and inference.

• Demonstrated success in developing and refining high-throughput, low-latency systems, including the ability to reason across software stacks, hardware capabilities, and system bottlenecks.

• Strong collaboration skills in a multi-national, interdisciplinary setting, with the ability to contribute ideas, build momentum, and work effectively with senior engineers, researchers, and partner teams.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

• Deep expertise with NCCL, UCX, UCC, or similar communication libraries used in large-scale AI and HPC workloads.

• Strong background in networking and communication protocols, RDMA, collective communications, congestion-aware transport, or accelerator-aware networking.

• Comprehensive knowledge of large model training and inference serving at scale, including communication bottlenecks, scheduling challenges, and system-level tradeoffs across compute, memory, and fabric.

• Experience crafting hardware-software co-design for distributed AI systems, including contribu

Il ruolo sottolinea la formazione distribuita, l'inferenza in tempo reale e l'efficienza della comunicazione attraverso grandi sistemi. Sviluppi nuovi approcci software e hardware, modella l'evoluzione della piattaforma attraverso l'innovazione hands-on e contribuisce a progettare sistemi che alimentano i carichi di lavoro AI più veloci a livello globale. • Costruire ed evolvere l'architettura di sistemi software scalabili per la formazione e l'inferenza di AI distribuiti, concentrandosi su throughput, latenza, resilienza e l'efficienza della memoria attraverso le implementazioni su scala di cluster.
• Sviluppare e valutare le capacità di comunicazione e runtime di nuova generazione in librerie come NCCL, UCX e UCC, adattate alle esigenze in evoluzione dei carichi di lavoro AI di frontiera.
• Partner con team di framework AI (ad esempio TensorFlow, PyTorch, JAX) e team di piattaforme interne per costruire integrazioni, esplorare nuovi approcci e migliorare le prestazioni e l'affidabilità end-to-end.
• Collaborare su funzionalità hardware e di livello di sistema attraverso GPU, DPU e interconnessioni per velocizzare il movimento dei dati e abilitare nuove funzionalità per la formazione, l'inferenza e il modello che servono in scala.
• Guida l'innovazione attraverso sistemi runtime, librerie di comunicazione e strati di protocollo specifici per l'intelligenza artificiale, aiutando a trasformare nuove idee in funzionalità pratiche e implementazioni robuste. Cosa dobbiamo vedere:
• Ph.D., o equivalente esperienza del settore, in informatica, ingegneria informatica, o un campo strettamente correlato.
• 5+ anni di esperienza nella programmazione di sistemi, calcolo parallelo o distribuito, networking ad alte prestazioni o movimento di dati su larga scala, tra cui la progettazione di esperienze e sistemi complessi di costruzione.
• Forte background di programmazione in C++, Python, e idealmente CUDA o altri modelli di programmazione GPU, con un track record di produzione-qualità di prestazioni-critical software.
• Ampia esperienza pratica con i framework AI (per esempio PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX) e una solida comprensione di come le librerie di comunicazione e i sistemi runtime facilitino la formazione su larga scala e l'inferenza.
• Dimostrato successo nello sviluppo e nella raffinazione di sistemi ad alto rendimento, bassa latenza, tra cui la capacità di ragionare tra stack software, funzionalità hardware e strozzature di sistema.
• Forte capacità di collaborazione in un ambiente multi-nazionale, interdisciplinare, con la capacità di contribuire idee, costruire slancio e lavorare efficacemente con ingegneri senior, ricercatori e team partner. Modi per distinguersi dalla folla:
• Profonda competenza con le librerie di comunicazione NCCL, UCX, UCC o simili utilizzate nei carichi di lavoro AI e HPC su larga scala.
• Forte sfondo nei protocolli di rete e comunicazione, RDMA, comunicazioni collettive, trasporto congestion-aware, o networking acceleratore-consapevole.
• Conoscenza completa della formazione e dell'inferenza di modelli di grandi dimensioni che servono a scala, compresi i colli di bottiglia di comunicazione, le sfide di programmazione e i tradeoff di livello di sistema in elaborazione, memoria e tessuto.
• Esperienza artigianato hardware-software co-design per i sistemi AI distribuiti, compreso il contributo

jobs.title: Senior Compiler Engineer
jobs.description:
We are looking to hire a CPU Compiler Engineer for an exciting and fun role at NVIDIA. We craft outstanding compilers that realise the potential of NVIDIA's CPUs designed for the world's largest AI and HPC workloads: https://www.nvidia.com/en-in/data-center/grace-cpu/ . Our compiler organisation makes its mark on every CPU, GPU, DPU and SoC product that NVIDIA builds. Would you like to be part of this outstanding organisation?

We need you to design, develop and help improve the upstream LLVM Toolchain for NVIDIA's CPUs. These compilers are key for the performance of AI, HPC and other performance critical software deployed on NVIDIA Data Centres, on the cloud and at super computing centres around the world. In this role you will solve critical problems working alongside an outstanding engineering team with vision in Compiler technology and systems software, doing what you enjoy! You will also be collaborating with the relevant upstream projects and improving the state of the art. If this sounds like a fun challenge, we would be delighted to hear from you!!

What you will be doing:

• Work with a geographically distributed partner organisation to understand, modify and improve CPU Compiler SW at NVIDIA.

• Contribute new features and optimisation techniques targeting NVIDIA Grace CPUs engaging with upstream and open source communities.

• Develop compiler SW that is optimised for performance.

• Be part of a team that is at the centre of AI, HPC and data centre technologies.

• Help in the development of next generation CPU micro-architecture.

What we need to see:

• BS or MS degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field or equivalent experience

• More than 12 years of experience with compiler development in a production environment.

• Knowledge of Language Front-Ends or Compiler optimisation techniques and code generation modules.

• Strong hands-on C++ programming skills

• Excellent verbal and written communications skills

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

• Familiarity with CPU architectures such as Arm Architecture (AArch32, AArch64), RISC-V, x86_64, PowerPC or DSPs and engaging with pre-silicon compiler and toolchain contributions.

• A track record of working with industry standard compiler infrastructure such as LLVM

• Knowledge of AI algorithms, scientific HPC applications and related code optimisations.

• Meaningful contributions to free software and open source compiler communities.

With highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package, NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most innovative and talented people on the planet working for us and, due to unprecedented growth, our world-class engineering teams are expanding fast. If you're a creative and autonomous engineer with a genuine passion for technology, we want to hear from you.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

titleByLocale.it: Systems Software Ingegnere, Kubernetes Scale - DGX Cloud

jobs.description:
The DGX Cloud organization at NVIDIA brings together cutting-edge hardware and software innovation to deliver industry-leading accelerated computing for the world's most adventurous AI workloads. We're a team of innovative engineers dedicated to solving some of the world's biggest challenges, constantly driving advancements, and impacting millions of lives worldwide!

We are looking for an outstanding Systems Software Engineer with deep experience in distributed systems, open-source technologies such as Kubernetes and containers, and a strong background in systems performance and scalability. The ideal candidate brings broad, end-to-end experience across the stack - from GPU operator and device plugins to distributed inference serving and cloud platforms - along with the technical depth to investigate and address exciting, real-world problems at scale. In this pivotal role, you will take on the challenge of scaling AI infrastructure while optimizing total cost of ownership, driving down cost per token to unlock the next generation of AI innovation and AI factories!

What you'll be doing:

• Drive end-to-end performance and scale characterization for the NVIDIA DGX Cloud software stack, from Kubernetes control and data planes through NVIDIA components such as GPU Operator, Network Operator, DCGM, NIM, and distributed inference serving, following issues from orchestration down to the metal.

• Collaborate with AI researchers, developers and customers to develop innovative, automated tests that simulate real user workloads using custom-built and leading open-source tools and frameworks.

• Deep dive into performance and scale issues in complex distributed systems, including interactions between Kubernetes and the NVIDIA software stack, to identify and resolve root causes.

• Design and develop monitoring, reporting and analysis tools for performance and scale testing across software, GPU and CPU resources.

• Triage, debug and root cause issues related to operating Kubernetes clusters at ultra-large scale, ensuring reliability and efficiency.

• Build and maintain a high-velocity framework that enables continuous, always-on performance and scale testing via a modern CI/CD pipeline.

• Document research, methodologies and results clearly and concisely, and present findings at internal and external venues, including community conferences such as KubeCon and GTC.

• Engage efficiently with upstream communities — including Kubernetes, CNCF and NVIDIA open-source projects — to validate performance and scalability of AI workloads early and help shape design and development decisions.

What we need to see:

• 2+ years of experience Computer Architecture, Networking, Storage systems, Accelerators and Bachelors/Masters in Engineering (preferably, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or Computer Science) or equivalent experience

• Expertise in Kubernetes and familiarity with related CNCF projects

• Background in working with large scale parallel and distributed accelerator-based systems

• Expertise optimizing performance and AI workloads on large scale systems

• Experience with performance modeling and benchmarking at scale

• Proficiency in Golang/Python

• Background with the NVIDIA software ecosystem in both training and inference domains

• Expertise with at least one of public CSP infrastructure (GCP, AWS, Azure, OCI for example)

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

• Strong operational experience with any one of the Kubernetes distributions

• Prior experience scaling Kubernetes clusters to ultra-large node and object counts

• Demonstrated history of working in the open-source community

• Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities

• PhD in relevant areas

NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. If you're creative and autonomous, we want to hear from you!

Your base

• Competenza ottimizzando le prestazioni e i carichi di lavoro AI su sistemi su larga scala
• Esperienza con modellazione delle prestazioni e benchmarking su scala

jobs.title: Principal Developer Technology Engineer
jobs.description:
For two decades, NVIDIA has pioneered visual computing, the art and science of computer graphics. With our invention of the GPU - the engine of modern visual computing - the field has expanded to encompass PC games, movie production, product design, medical diagnosis, scientific research and all things AI. Today, AI and visual computing are becoming increasingly central to how people interact with technology, and there has never been a more exciting time to join our team.

We are now looking for a Principal Developer Technology Engineer to focus on advanced rendering, including path tracing and neural graphics, and the broader adoption of AI technology in games.

What you’ll be doing:

• Collaborate with some of the most innovative, leading AAA developers throughout the world to optimize GPU and system performance, to ensure the fastest and most fluid gameplay with beautiful path traced neural rendering and complex AI behaviors.

• Develop, profile, optimize, and tune neural rendering algorithms and AI models to make the most of available computing resources.

• Collaborate with the architecture and driver teams at NVIDIA in ensuring the best possible experience on current generation hardware, and on determining trends and features for next generation architectures.

• Play with the latest GPU technology to develop new techniques using GPUs, build technical demos, write whitepapers and present your work at conferences.

What we need to see:

• Masters degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related computationally focused science degree (or equivalent experience).

• You have 15+ years of relevant work experience or research.

• Proficiency in C++ with strong software development, optimization, debugging skills, and a strong software engineering background.

• Very strong math skills, including linear algebra and calculus for problem-solving and performance modeling.

• Excellent knowledge of real-time graphics and GPU technologies (real-time rendering algorithms including ray/path tracing, shaders, shading languages, and APIs such as DirectX or Vulkan).

• Hands-on experience with low-level performance optimizations.

• In-depth expertise with CPU and GPU architecture fundamentals.

• A solid understanding of AI fundamentals with the ability to not only use AI tools for programming productivity but also to design new solutions.

• Good communication, organization and prioritization skills.

• Open to travel for on-site visits with developers and for conferences.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

• Professional experience in machine learning algorithms and applications.

• Experience optimizing inference and training workloads.

• Solid understanding of Neural Graphics techniques.

• Experience with Windows or Linux driver development.

#LI-Hybrid

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. For Poland: The base salary range is 483,750 PLN - 838,500 PLN.

jobs.description:
Reinforcement learning post-training is driving some of the most significant capability gains in AI today. It is the process that teaches a model to reason through hard problems, follow complex instructions, and act as an autonomous agent. It is also one of the hardest infrastructure challenges in the field. RL requires inference, rollout generation, and training running in a continuous loop. The rollout step is what makes it hard: the model must interact with environments, tools, and other models to produce the signal that drives learning. Coordinating actor, critic, and reward models across heterogeneous hardware at scale pushes the limits of what distributed systems can do.

NVIDIA is building an RL Frameworks engineering team to develop the open-source tools and infrastructure that AI researchers and post-training teams depend on. The team spans the full software stack, from collaborating closely with the researchers and labs pushing the frontier, to contributing to RL frameworks like VeRL , Miles , and TorchTitan , to improving the distributed runtimes they depend on, including Ray and Monarch . Whether your strength is working with researchers to understand and address their need optimizing deep learning frameworks, or building distributed infrastructure, we want to hear from you. Come join us to build the systems that enable the next generation of AI.

What you will be doing:
You will architect and build RL post-training infrastructure that scales efficiently from experimentation on a single GPU to production across thousands of nodes. Verstärkungslernen nach dem Training treibt heute einige der wichtigsten Fähigkeiten in der KI voran. Es ist der Prozess, der ein Modell lehrt, schwierige Probleme zu durchdenken, komplexen Anweisungen zu folgen und als autonomer Agent zu handeln. Es ist auch eine der schwierigsten Infrastrukturherausforderungen in diesem Bereich. RL erfordert Inferenz, Rollout-Generierung und Training in einer kontinuierlichen Schleife. Der Rollout-Schritt macht es schwierig: Das Modell muss mit Umgebungen, Tools und anderen Modellen interagieren, um das Signal zu erzeugen, das das Lernen antreibt. Die Koordination von Akteur-, Kritiker- und Belohnungsmodellen über heterogene Hardware in großem Maßstab erweitert die Grenzen dessen, was verteilte Systeme leisten können. NVIDIA baut ein RL Frameworks Engineering-Team auf, um die Open-Source-Tools und Infrastruktur zu entwickeln, auf die KI-Forscher und Post-Training-Teams angewiesen sind. Das Team umfasst den gesamten Software-Stack, von der engen Zusammenarbeit mit den Forschern und Labors, die die Grenze überschreiten, über den Beitrag zu RL-Frameworks wie VeRL, Miles und TorchTitan bis hin zur Verbesserung der verteilten Laufzeiten, von denen sie abhängen, einschließlich Ray und Monarch. Ob Ihre Stärke darin besteht, mit Forschern zusammenzuarbeiten, um ihre Bedürfnisse zu verstehen und zu erfüllen, um Deep Learning-Frameworks zu optimieren oder eine verteilte Infrastruktur aufzubauen, möchten wir von Ihnen hören. Le renforcement de l'apprentissage post-formation est à l'origine de certains des gains de capacité les plus importants dans l'IA aujourd'hui. C'est le processus qui enseigne un modèle à raisonner à travers des problèmes difficiles, suivre des instructions complexes, et agir comme un agent autonome. C'est aussi l'un des défis les plus difficiles en matière d'infrastructure sur le terrain. RL nécessite une inférence, une génération de déploiement et une formation en boucle continue. L'étape de déploiement est ce qui rend difficile: le modèle doit interagir avec les environnements, les outils et d'autres modèles pour produire le signal qui conduit à l'apprentissage. Coordonner les modèles d'acteur, de critique et de récompense sur des matériels hétérogènes à l'échelle pousse les limites de ce que les systèmes distribués peuvent faire. NVIDIA met sur pied une équipe d'ingénieurs RL Frameworks pour développer les outils et l'infrastructure open-source dont dépendent les chercheurs en IA et les équipes post-formation. L'équipe s'étend sur toute la pile de logiciels, de la collaboration étroite avec les chercheurs et les laboratoires poussant la frontière, à la contribution aux cadres RL comme VERL , Miles , et TorchTitan , à l'amélioration des temps d'exécution distribués dont ils dépendent, y compris Ray et Monarch . Que votre force travaille avec les chercheurs pour comprendre et répondre à leur besoin d'optimiser les cadres d'apprentissage profond, ou de construire une infrastructure distribuée, nous voulons vous entendre. Venez nous rejoindre pour construire les systèmes qui permettent la prochaine génération d'IA. Ce que vous ferez : Vous allez architecter et construire une infrastructure RL post-formation qui s'échelonne efficacement de l'expérimentation sur un seul GPU à la production à travers des milliers de nœuds. Il s'agit de mettre au point des boucles RL-inférence-rollout sur les GPU, les CPU et les LPU pour les performances où elles sont importantes, de contribuer et d'améliorer les performances et la facilité d'utilisation des cadres RL open-source, et de s'associer avec les équipes qui les possèdent. Le rôle s'étend également à la tolérance aux défauts, à l'échelle élastique et au redémarrage rapide si long terme des emplois d'entraînement répartis survivent aux échecs, aux pièges et aux disputes en matière de ressources. Au-delà de la formation accélérée par le GPU, ce travail comprend le partenariat avec des équipes qui construisent des charges de travail de déploiement entraînées par le CPU, y compris l'utilisation d'outils, l'exécution de codes et des environnements d'agents, fournissant les systèmes et l'ingénierie-cadre nécessaires pour les exécuter efficacement aux côtés de la génération accélérée par le GPU ou le LPU et de la formation accélérée par le GPU. Il s'agit aussi de défendre les besoins des chercheurs et des partenaires auprès des équipes de réseautage, de la bibliothèque de mathématiques et du compilateur de NVIDIA, de sorte que les capacités de charge de travail RL doivent être hiérarchisées et livrées, et de travailler avec les équipes de matériel pour tirer parti des capacités matérielles de nouvelle génération dans les charges de travail post-formation. Ce que nous devons voir :
• MS ou doctorat en informatique, en génie informatique ou dans un domaine connexe (ou expérience équivalente)
• 5+ ans d'expérience professionnelle dans les systèmes distribués, l'informatique haute performance, l'infrastructure d'apprentissage profond ou l'ingénierie des systèmes ML
• Forte compétence en Python et en C/C++
• Expérience démontrée de la construction ou de la contribution à des systèmes distribués à grande échelle ou à des cadres d'exécution dans la production d'un laboratoire d'IA frontalier, d'un hyperéchelleur ou d'une entreprise technologique majeure
• Forte capacité de communication verbale et écrite et capacité de collaboration au-delà des frontières organisationnelles et géographiques Profondeur dans un ou plusieurs des domaines techniques suivants:

jobs.title: Senior CPU Compiler Performance Engineer
jobs.description:
We are looking to hire a senior CPU Compiler performance Engineer for an exciting and fun role at NVIDIA. We craft outstanding compilers that realise the potential of NVIDIA's CPUs designed for the world's largest AI and computing markets: https://www.nvidia.com/en-in/data-center/grace-cpu/ . Our compiler organisation makes its mark on every CPU, GPU and compute unit that NVIDIA builds. Would you like to be part of this outstanding organisation?

We need you to design compiler and hardware software together including developing new technologies to help with hardware software co-design. These compilers are key for the performance of AI, HPC and other performance critical software deployed on NVIDIA Data Centres, on the cloud and at super computing centres around the world. In this role you will solve critical problems working alongside an outstanding engineering team with vision in Compiler technology and systems software, doing what you enjoy! You will also be collaborating with the relevant upstream projects and improving the state of the art If this sounds like a fun challenge, we would be delighted to hear from you!!

What you will be doing:

• Work with a geographically distributed partner organisation to understand, modify and improve CPU Compiler SW at NVIDIA.

• Analyse AI workloads to champion improvements in both new hardware and compiler toolchain and improve hardware-software co-design.

• Contribute new features and optimisation techniques targeting NVIDIA CPUs engaging with upstream and open source communities.

• Develop compiler SW that is optimised for performance.

• Be part of a team that is at the centre of artificial intelligence, high-performance computing and data centre technologies.

• Contribute towards the development of next generation compute

What we need to see:

• BS, MS or higher degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field or equivalent work experience with 8+ years of work experience.

• Experience with compiler development or a related academic project.

• Knowledge of Language Front-Ends or Compiler optimisation techniques and code generation modules.

• Strong hands-on C++ programming skills

• Good CPU architecture and low level performance analysis skills with hands-on experience of pre-Silicon hardware / software co-design.

• Excellent verbal and written communications skills

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

• Knowledge of workload analysis and the ability to drive improvements in hardware ,software, libraries and compilers including demonstrable ability of effectively improving hardware and software by all performance tools at disposal including but not limited to performance modeling / simulation and performance analysis tools.

• Expertise with CPU architectures such as Arm Architecture (AArch32, AArch64), RISC-V, x86_64, PowerPC or DSPs and engaging with pre-silicon compiler and toolchain contributions.

• A track record of working with industry standard compiler infrastructure such as GCC, LLVM or MLIR

• Knowledge of AI algorithms, scientific HPC applications and related code optimisations.

• Significant contributions to free software and open source compiler communities.

With highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package, NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most innovative and talented people on the planet working for us and, due to unprecedented growth, our world-class engineering teams are expanding fast. If you're a creative and autonomous engineer with a genuine passion for technology, we would love to connect with you.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

• Conoscenza delle tecniche di ottimizzazione del linguaggio Front-Ends o Compiler e dei moduli di generazione del codice.

• Forte hands-on C++ competenze di programmazione

• Buona architettura della CPU e capacità di analisi delle prestazioni di basso livello con esperienza pratica di co-design hardware/software pre-Silicon.

• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione verbale e scritta

• Conoscenza dell'analisi del carico di lavoro e la capacità di migliorare i miglioramenti dell'hardware, del software, delle librerie e dei compilatori, tra cui la capacità dimostrabile di migliorare efficacemente l'hardware e il software da tutti gli strumenti di performance a disposizione, inclusi ma non limitati agli strumenti di modellazione/analisi delle prestazioni e delle prestazioni.

jobs.description:
Our work at NVIDIA is dedicated towards a computing model focused on visual and AI computing. For two decades, NVIDIA has pioneered visual computing, the art and science of computer graphics, with our invention of the GPU. The GPU has also shown to be spectacularly effective at solving some of the most complex problems in computer science. Today, NVIDIA’s GPU simulates human intelligence, running deep learning algorithms and acting as the brain of computers, robots and self-driving cars that can perceive and understand the world. We are looking to grow our company and teams with the smartest people in the world and there has never been a more exciting time to join us!

NVIDIA is redefining what’s possible with AI, and our Relational Foundation Model team is at the forefront of that mission. We’re building a single, unified foundation model that understands the structure and relationships within any relational database or heterogeneous graph — a fundamentally new approach to enterprise AI. As an engineer on this team, you won’t just be fine-tuning existing models; you’ll be designing and experimenting with novel Transformer and GNN architectures that generalize across diverse relational schemas. Your work will directly impact real-world applications spanning recommendation systems, demand forecasting, fraud detection, and predictive maintenance — all powered by one extensible model. You’ll collaborate closely with researchers and engineers across the full ML lifecycle, from architecture exploration and large-scale training to post-training optimization and inference acceleration. This is a rare opportunity to contribute to foundational research that ships into production and shapes the modern data stack. If you’re excited about graph learning, relational reasoning, and building AI systems that go far beyond single-table benchmarks, this is the team for you.

What you’ll be doing:

• Collaborate with researchers/engineers to enhance our Transformer and GNN-based models to operate seamlessly over any relational schema and heterogeneous graph.

• Gain hands-on experience with high-impact use cases such as forecasting, entity matching, customer retention and fraud detection – all built on top of a single, extensible foundation model.

• Leverage your knowledge in ML and AI to tackle real challenges while contributing to scalable and adaptable solutions that push the boundaries of what’s possible.

• Work may span the full lifecycle of modern ML systems: from architecture design/training to post-training optimization and inference acceleration.

• You will contribute to our next generation of the Relational Foundation Model.

What we need to see:

• MS or PhD in Machine Learning, Computer Science, or equivalent program

• Proficiency in Python and deep learning frameworks, such as PyTorch

• At least 8 years of research experience in designing ML algorithm solutions

• Practical experience in using Predictive Models in Real World Applications

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

• Familiarity with graph-based machine learning; publications at venues such as NeurIPS, ICLR, ICML, or similar

NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. If you're creative and autonomous, we want to hear from you!

descriptionByLocale.it:
Il nostro lavoro a NVIDIA è dedicato a un modello di calcolo focalizzato sul visual e sull'intelligenza artificiale. Per due decenni, NVIDIA è pioniera del visual computing, dell'arte e della scienza della grafica informatica, con la nostra invenzione della GPU. La GPU ha anche dimostrato di essere spettacolare efficace nel risolvere alcuni dei problemi più complessi in informatica. Oggi, la GPU di NVIDIA simula l'intelligenza umana, l'esecuzione di algoritmi di apprendimento profondo e l'azione come il cervello di computer, robot e auto-driving automobili che possono percepire e comprendere il mondo. Stiamo cercando di crescere la nostra azienda e team con le persone più intelligenti del mondo e non c'è mai stato un momento più emozionante per unirsi a noi!

NVIDIA sta ridefinindo ciò che è possibile con l'IA, e il nostro team di Modelli di Fondazione relazionale è all'avanguardia di quella missione. Stiamo costruendo un unico modello di fondazione unificato che comprende la struttura e le relazioni all'interno di qualsiasi database relazionale o grafico eterogeneo — un approccio fondamentalmente nuovo all'intelligenza artificiale aziendale. In qualità di ingegnere di questo team, non sarete solo modelli predefiniti; state progettando e sperimentando nuove architetture Transformer e GNN che generalizzano attraverso diversi schemi relazionali. Il vostro lavoro influenzerà direttamente le applicazioni del mondo reale che spaziano dai sistemi di raccomandazione, la previsione della domanda, il rilevamento delle frodi e la manutenzione predittiva — tutto alimentato da un modello estensivo. Collaborerai a stretto contatto con ricercatori e ingegneri in tutto il ciclo di vita ML, dall'esplorazione dell'architettura e dalla formazione su larga scala all'ottimizzazione post-training e all'accelerazione dell'inferenza. Questa è una rara opportunità di contribuire alla ricerca fondamentale che navi in produzione e modella la pila di dati moderna. Se siete entusiasti di apprendimento grafico, ragionamento relazionale, e la costruzione di sistemi AI che vanno ben oltre i benchmark single-table, questo è il team per voi.

Cosa farai:

• Collabora con ricercatori/ingegner per migliorare i nostri modelli basati su Transformer e GNN per operare senza soluzione di continuità su qualsiasi schema relazionale e grafico eterogeneo.

• Guadagna esperienza pratica con casi di utilizzo ad alto impatto come la previsione, l'accoppiamento di entità, la ritenzione del cliente e il rilevamento delle frodi – tutto costruito sopra un unico, modello di fondazione estensibile.

• Sfrutta le tue conoscenze in ML e AI per affrontare sfide reali, contribuendo a soluzioni scalabili e adattabili che spingono i confini di ciò che è possibile.

• Il lavoro può durare il ciclo di vita completo dei moderni sistemi ML: dal design dell'architettura/formazione all'ottimizzazione post-training e all'accelerazione dell'inferenza.

• Contribuirai alla nostra prossima generazione del Modello della Fondazione Relazionale.

Cosa dobbiamo vedere:

• MS o PhD nell'apprendimento automatico, Scienza informatica o programma equivalente

• Proficienza in Python e nei quadri di apprendimento profondi, come PyTorch

• Almeno 8 anni di esperienza di ricerca nella progettazione di soluzioni algoritmo ML

• Esperienza pratica nell'utilizzo di Modelli Predictive in Applicazioni Real World

Modi per distinguersi dalla folla:

• Familiarità con l'apprendimento automatico basato sui grafici; pubblicazioni in luoghi come NeurIPS, ICLR, ICML o simili

NVIDIA è ampiamente considerato uno dei datori di lavoro più desiderabili del mondo tecnologico. Abbiamo alcune delle persone più avanzate e laboriose al mondo che lavorano per noi. Se sei creativo e autonomo, vogliamo sentirti!

descriptionByLocale.de:
Unsere Arbeit bei NVIDIA widmet sich einem Computermodell, das sich auf visuelles und KI-Computing konzentriert. Seit zwei Jahrzehnten ist NVIDIA mit unserer Erfindung der GPU Pionier im Bereich Visual Computing, der Kunst und Wissenschaft der Computergrafik. Die GPU hat sich auch als spektakulär effektiv bei der Lösung einiger der komplexesten Probleme in der Informatik erwiesen. Heute simuliert die GPU von NVIDIA die menschliche Intelligenz, führt Deep-Learning-Algorithmen aus und fungiert als Gehirn von Computern, Robotern und selbstfahrenden Autos, die die Welt wahrnehmen und verstehen können. Wir wollen unser Unternehmen und unsere Teams mit den klügsten Menschen der Welt ausbauen, und es gab noch nie eine aufregendere Zeit, sich uns anzuschließen!

NVIDIA definiert neu, was mit KI möglich ist, und unser Team von Relational Foundation Model steht an vorderster Front dieser Mission. Wir bauen ein einziges, einheitliches Grundlagenmodell auf, das die Struktur und die Beziehungen in jeder relationalen Datenbank oder jedem heterogenen Graphen versteht - ein grundlegend neuer Ansatz für Unternehmens-KI. Als Ingenieur in diesem Team werden Sie nicht nur bestehende Modelle verfeinern, sondern auch neuartige Transformer- und GNN-Architekturen entwerfen und experimentieren, die sich über verschiedene relationale Schemata hinweg verallgemeinern. Ihre Arbeit wirkt sich direkt auf reale Anwendungen aus, die Empfehlungssysteme, Bedarfsvorhersage, Betrugserkennung und vorausschauende Wartung umfassen - alles mit einem erweiterbaren Modell. Sie arbeiten eng mit Forschern und Ingenieuren während des gesamten ML-Lebenszyklus zusammen, von der Architekturerkundung und groß angelegten Schulungen bis hin zur Optimierung nach dem Training und der Inferenzbeschleunigung. Dies ist eine seltene Gelegenheit, einen Beitrag zur Grundlagenforschung zu leisten, die in Produktion geht und den modernen Datenstapel formt. Wenn Sie sich für Graphenlernen, relationales Denken und den Aufbau von KI-Systemen interessieren, die weit über Single-Table-Benchmarks hinausgehen, ist dies das richtige Team für Sie.

Was du tun wirst:

• Arbeiten Sie mit Forschern/Ingenieuren zusammen, um unsere Transformer- und GNN-basierten Modelle so zu verbessern, dass sie nahtlos über alle relationalen Schemata und heterogenen Graphen hinweg funktionieren.

• Sammeln Sie praktische Erfahrungen mit hochwirksamen Anwendungsfällen wie Prognosen, Entity Matching, Kundenbindung und Betrugserkennung - alles auf der Grundlage eines einzigen, erweiterbaren Fundamentmodells.

• Nutzen Sie Ihr Wissen in ML und KI, um echte Herausforderungen anzugehen und gleichzeitig zu skalierbaren und anpassungsfähigen Lösungen beizutragen, die die Grenzen des Möglichen erweitern.

• Die Arbeit kann den gesamten Lebenszyklus moderner ML-Systeme umfassen: vom Architekturdesign/-training bis zur Optimierung nach dem Training und der Inferenzbeschleunigung.

• Sie werden zu unserer nächsten Generation des Relational Foundation Model beitragen.

Was wir sehen müssen:

• MS oder PhD in Machine Learning, Informatik oder gleichwertigem Programm

• Kenntnisse in Python und Deep Learning Frameworks, wie PyTorch

• Mindestens 8 Jahre Forschungserfahrung in der Entwicklung von ML-Algorithmuslösungen

• Praktische Erfahrung im Einsatz von Predictive Models in Real World Applications

Möglichkeiten, sich von der Masse abzuheben:

• Vertrautheit mit graphenbasiertem maschinellem Lernen; Veröffentlichungen an Orten wie NeurIPS, ICLR, ICML oder ähnlichem

NVIDIA gilt weithin als einer der begehrtesten Arbeitgeber der Technologie weltweit. Wir haben einige der fortschrittlichsten und fleißigsten Menschen der Welt, die für uns arbeiten. Wenn Sie kreativ und autonom sind, möchten wir von Ihnen hören!
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Notre travail chez NVIDIA est dédié à un modèle informatique axé sur le calcul visuel et l'intelligence artificielle. Depuis deux décennies, NVIDIA est le pionnier de l'informatique visuelle, de l'art et de la science de l'informatique, avec notre invention du GPU. Le GPU s'est également révélé spectaculairement efficace pour résoudre certains des problèmes les plus complexes en informatique. Aujourd'hui, le GPU de NVIDIA simule l'intelligence humaine, exécute des algorithmes d'apprentissage profond et agit comme le cerveau d'ordinateurs, de robots et de voitures autonomes qui peuvent percevoir et comprendre le monde. Nous cherchons à développer notre entreprise et nos équipes avec les personnes les plus intelligentes du monde et il n'y a jamais eu de temps plus excitant pour nous rejoindre!

NVIDIA redéfinit ce qui est possible avec l'IA, et notre équipe de modèle de fondation relationnelle est à l'avant-garde de cette mission. Nous construisons un modèle de fondation unique et unifié qui comprend la structure et les relations au sein de toute base de données relationnelle ou graphique hétérogène, une approche fondamentalement nouvelle de l'IA d'entreprise. En tant qu'ingénieur dans cette équipe, vous n'avez pas seulement à affiner les modèles existants; vous allez concevoir et expérimenter des architectures de Transformer et GNN nouvelles qui généralisent à travers divers schémas relationnels. Votre travail aura une incidence directe sur les applications du monde réel couvrant les systèmes de recommandation, la prévision de la demande, la détection de fraude et la maintenance prédictive, toutes alimentées par un modèle extensible. Vous collaborerez étroitement avec les chercheurs et les ingénieurs tout au long du cycle de vie du ML, de l'exploration de l'architecture et de la formation à grande échelle à l'optimisation post-formation et à l'accélération de l'inférence. C'est une occasion rare de contribuer à la recherche fondamentale qui mène à la production et façonne la pile de données moderne. Si vous êtes excité par l'apprentissage du graphique, le raisonnement relationnel et la construction de systèmes d'IA qui vont bien au-delà des points de repère à table unique, c'est l'équipe pour vous.

Ce que vous allez faire:

• Collaborer avec les chercheurs/ingénieurs pour améliorer nos modèles de Transformer et GNN afin de fonctionner de façon transparente sur n'importe quel schéma relationnel et graphique hétérogène.

• Acquérir une expérience pratique avec des cas d'utilisation à fort impact tels que la prévision, l'appariement d'entités, la rétention des clients et la détection de fraude – tous construits sur un modèle de fondation unique et extensible.

• Profitez de vos connaissances en ML et en AI pour relever de vrais défis tout en contribuant à des solutions évolutives et adaptables qui repoussent les limites de ce qui est possible.

• Le travail peut s'étendre sur tout le cycle de vie des systèmes modernes de ML : de la conception/formation en architecture à l'optimisation après la formation et à l'accélération de l'inférence.

• Vous contribuerez à notre prochaine génération du modèle de fondation relationnelle.

Ce que nous devons voir :

• MS ou doctorat en apprentissage automatique, informatique ou programme équivalent

• Compétence en Python et cadres d'apprentissage profond, comme PyTorch

• Au moins 8 ans d'expérience dans la conception de solutions d'algorithmes ML

• Expérience pratique dans l'utilisation des modèles prédictifs dans les applications du monde réel

Des façons de se démarquer de la foule :

• Connaissance de l'apprentissage automatique par graphe; publications dans des lieux tels que le NeurIPS, le CILR, le CIML ou d'autres lieux similaires

NVIDIA est largement considéré comme l'un des employeurs les plus souhaitables du monde de la technologie. Nous avons quelques-uns des gens les plus tournés vers l'avenir et les plus travailleurs du monde qui travaillent pour nous. Si vous êtes créatif et autonome, nous voulons vous entendre !

jobs.title: Senior Software and System Architect
jobs.description:
NVIDIA is looking for an outstanding passionate and talented Senior SW & System Architect to join our SW Architecture group. The position includes researching new technologies with focus on architecture definition of groundbreaking technologies in different domains - networking, security, virtualization and orchestration. NVIDIA Architecture group consists of world-class architects responsible for designing the next generation state-of-the-art architecture for our DPUs & NICs technologies. You will play a key role defining the future of cloud solution stack, from HW to Application level, including orchestration, provisioning, network programmability and SDN. You will be working with various teams around the world including SW architects, R&D, product, solution architects and external customers. This position offers a unique and exceptional opportunity to have real impact in a dynamic, technology-focused company shaping the future of data-centers technologies.

What you will be doing:

• Lead architecture for cloud-networking including orchestration, provisioning and security solutions

• Design state-of-the-art system architecture for DPUs & NICs technologies

• Build end-to-end solutions from application level to HW

• Responsible for writing effective, clear and reliable architecture specification

• Evaluate new technologies and innovate & rapidly develop POC prototypes that can then be developed into full-fledged products/solutions

• Work closely with different NVIDIA teams around the world including sw & hw architects, R&D, product, solution architects, application and field engineers and more

• Work with high profile customers on advanced and future technologies and solutions

What we need to see:

• B.Sc/M.Sc/Phd degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or Electrical Engineering

• 4+ years of experience as SW Architect/System Architect

• 4+ years of experience as SW developer

• Deep knowledge and experience with C, Python

• Hands on Linux development, Docker and Containers based technologies

• Experience with cloud and Data Center networking

• Wide knowledge and understanding of networking protocols and common network topologies

• Strong design, coding, analytical, debugging and problem-solving skills

• Ability to work concurrently with multiple groups locally and abroad in the organization

• Excellent communication, documentation and presentation skills

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

• Development experience with networking/security devices – NICs/DPUs/Switches/Routers /Firewalls etc.

• Experience with DPDK, OVS, OVN

• Background with Kubernetes components & subsystems, CRDs, Operators, system plugins and CNI plugin development (Calico, Flannel)

• Experience with OpenStack/OpenShift and/or Cloud APIs

• Familiarity with different automation tools such as Ansible

With competitive salaries and a generous benefits package, NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us and. due to unprecedented growth, our exclusive engineering teams are rapidly growing. If you're a creative and autonomous engineer with a real passion for technology, we want to hear from you.

NVIDIA is committed to fostering a diverse work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Solution Architect, Local Government AI
jobs.description:
Do you want to support our global, mission-focused government clients as they embrace AI to improve government services and increase the health, well-being, and safety of their citizens? NVIDIA is building the world’s leading AI company, one customer success at a time. Our solutions architects are key partners for our business and product teams and trusted advisors to our clients, helping them translate mission-focused goals into active AI enabled plans and actions. Specifically, we are looking for technical teammates that can help our business team develop and deploy strategies and collateral to our field teams in region and also directly support us as we educate potential clients, assist with proofs of concept, productization of workflows, and advise on successful delivery of services and solutions through our ecosystem of partners. Our team interacts regularly with colleagues, partners and customers across our global footprint. NVIDIA supports a flexible work environment where you are empowered to manage your work-life balance. Occasional international travel may be required.

What you will be doing:

• Empower and mentor partners, customers, and colleagues, sharing your expertise to help them grow and succeed.

• Play a key role in shaping and supporting strategic plans that drive innovation at national, regional, and city levels across diverse global communities. global region.

• Build engaging resources—such as presentations, blogs, and interactive notebooks—that connect business strategy with real-world government and community needs.

• Collaborate with customers’ technical teams, guiding and supporting them through hands-on field trials and solution deployments.

• Advocate for customer and partner needs by helping define product requirements and championing enhancements that remove barriers.

• Develop and demonstrate solutions based on NVIDIA’s groundbreaking AI software and hardware technologies to customers.

What we need to see:

• Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, Applied Statistics, Physics, Mathematics, or other Engineering fields or equivalent experience.

• At least five years experience in technical consulting, software development, or equivalent. At least three of those years should include delivering Computer Vision, Deep Learning, or Generative AI computing solutions or infrastructure.

• Experience with at least one of the following: fine tuning or deploying computer vision models (CNNs, ViT, VLM, Gen AI); fine tuning and deploying large language models; deploying agentic and Generative AI based solutions.

• Hands-on experience with Python, PyTorch and containers.

• Enjoy working with multiple levels and teams across organizations (engineering/research, product, sales and marketing teams).

• Effective verbal, written communications, and technical presentation skills including sharing your ideas/code clearly through blog posts and GitHub.

• Self-starter with a vision for growth, dedication to continuous learning and sharing findings across the team.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

• Prior work in government, AI startups, or working with digital twins.

• Development experience with Kubernetes, Helm or Slurm

• Experience with CICD and MLOPS technologies for building computer vision, NLP, Digital Twins or data analytics applications.

• Hands-on experience in creating solutions using NVIDIA software libraries and GPUs.

• Effective interpersonal and communications skills in additional languages and cultures, especially Spanish, Portuguese, French, German, Vietnamese, Thai, Bahasa, or Arabic.

NVIDIA supporta un ambiente di lavoro flessibile in cui sei abilitato a gestire il tuo equilibrio tra vita e lavoro. Possono essere richiesti viaggi internazionali occasionali.

Cosa farai:

• Affidare e mentore partner, clienti e colleghi, condividere le vostre competenze per aiutarli a crescere e avere successo.

• Svolgere un ruolo chiave nella definizione e nel supporto di piani strategici che spingono l'innovazione a livello nazionale, regionale e urbano in diverse comunità globali. regione globale.

• Costruire risorse coinvolgenti, come presentazioni, blog e notebook interattivi, che collegano la strategia aziendale con le esigenze di governo e comunità del mondo reale.

• Collabora con i team tecnici dei clienti, guidandoli e supportandoli attraverso test di campo pratici e implementazioni di soluzioni.

• Avvocato per le esigenze del cliente e del partner, aiutando a definire i requisiti del prodotto e valorizzando i miglioramenti che eliminano le barriere.

• Sviluppare e dimostrare soluzioni basate sulle tecnologie innovative AI e hardware di NVIDIA ai clienti.

Cosa dobbiamo vedere:

• Laurea magistrale in Informatica, Ingegneria Elettrica/Computer, Statistica applicata, Fisica, Matematica, o altri campi di ingegneria o esperienza equivalente.

• Almeno cinque anni di esperienza in consulenza tecnica, sviluppo software, o equivalente. Almeno tre di questi anni dovrebbero includere la fornitura di soluzioni informatiche, di deep learning o di soluzioni di calcolo Generative AI o infrastrutture.

• Esperienza con almeno uno dei seguenti modelli: messa a punto fine o implementazione di modelli di visione del computer (CNN, ViT, VLM, Gen AI); messa a punto e distribuzione di modelli di grande lingua; distribuzione di soluzioni basate su agentic e AI Generative.

• Esperienza pratica con Python, PyTorch e contenitori.

• Godetevi il lavoro con più livelli e team di organizzazioni (ingegneria/ricerca, prodotti, vendite e team di marketing).

• Efficace comunicazione verbale, scritta e capacità di presentazione tecnica, tra cui la condivisione delle vostre idee / codice chiaramente attraverso i post del blog e GitHub.

• Self-starter con una visione per la crescita, la dedizione all'apprendimento continuo e la condivisione dei risultati in tutta la squadra.

Modi per distinguersi dalla folla:

• Lavoro prioritario nel governo, startup AI, o lavorare con gemelli digitali.

• Esperienza di sviluppo con Kubernetes, Helm o Slurm

• Esperienza con le tecnologie CICD e MLOPS per la costruzione di applicazioni informatiche, NLP, Digital Twins o di analisi dei dati.

• Esperienza pratica nella creazione di soluzioni utilizzando librerie software NVIDIA e GPU.

• Efficace capacità interpersonali e di comunicazione in altre lingue e culture, in particolare spagnolo, portoghese, francese, tedesco, vietnamita, tailandese, Bahasa, o arabo.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, CUDA Core Libraries

titleByLocale.it: Senior Software Ingegnere, CUDA Core Libraries
titleByLocale.en: Senior Software Engineer, CUDA Core Libraries
titleByLocale.de: Senior Software Ingenieur, CUDA Core Libraries
titleByLocale.fr: Senior Software Ingénieur, CUDA Core Libraries

jobs.description:
NVIDIA’s accelerated computing platform is the foundation of modern HPC and AI.At the core of this platform are the CUDA Core Libraries. C++ and Python libraries that enable developers to write fast, reliable, and scalable GPU-accelerated software! We are hiring a full-time Software Engineer to work on the CUDA Core Libraries that power GPU computing for both C++ and Python developers. This includes projects such as CCCL (Thrust, CUB, libcudacxx), cuda-python, and numba-cuda. You will join the team building the foundational libraries, algorithms, and language/runtime infrastructure that make CUDA a speed-of-light experience for developers across deep learning, scientific computing, and data analytics!

What you’ll be doing:

• Develop and implement CUDA Core Libraries in C++ and/or Python, including parallel algorithms and idiomatic language bindings for core CUDA functionality.

• Compose, optimize, and evolve GPU algorithms and APIs, from high-level interfaces down to low-level performance tuning involving memory, parallelism, and synchronization.

• Own features end-to-end: develop, implementation, testing, benchmarking, documentation, and long-term maintenance.

• Improve developer experience across the stack: CI, tests, benchmarks, packaging, examples, and docs.

• Collaborate with senior CUDA engineers in design reviews, code reviews, and open-source-style workflows.

• Engage with real users through issues, performance investigations, and API feedback.

What we need to see:

• BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field or equivalent experience.

• Minimum of 8+ years of related development experience

• Strong programming skills in C++, Python, or both, with proven interest in systems-level software (performance, memory, concurrency, API design).

• Solid understanding of modern C++ (templates, generics, standard library) and/or Python library development and packaging.

• Practical experience with parallel or heterogeneous programming (CUDA, OpenMP, GPU-accelerated Python, or similar).

• Experience contributing to production software or open-source libraries, including testing, profiling, and code review.

• Ability to work independently, scope problems, and drive projects to completion.

• Clear written communication for technical design and documentation.

• Comfort navigating large, multi-language codebases (C++, Python, CMake, Pixi, CI systems).

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

• Strong understanding of CPU/GPU architecture and how hardware details affect performance.

• Hands-on experience with CUDA C++, CUDA Python, PyTorch, JAX, Numba, CuPy, or similar GPU-accelerated stacks.

• Familiarity with Thrust, CUB, libcudacxx, or other modern C++/GPU libraries.

• Experience with compiler infrastructure or tooling (LLVM, Clang tooling, MLIR).

• Demonstrated interest in developer tools, library design, and making other developers faster.

If you care deeply about performance, enjoy working at the C++/Python boundary, and want to shape the core CUDA libraries relied on by thousands of developers, this role is a direct fit.

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. For Poland: The base salary range is 292,500 PLN - 507,000 PLN for Level 4, and 375,000 PLN - 650,000 PLN for Level 5.

descriptionByLocale.it:

Al centro di questa piattaforma sono le biblioteche CUDA Core. librerie C++ e Python che permettono agli sviluppatori di scrivere un software veloce, affidabile e scalabile di accesso alla GPU! Stiamo assumendo un Software Engineer a tempo pieno per lavorare sulle CUDA Core Libraries che alimentano GPU computing sia per gli sviluppatori C++ che Python. Questo include progetti come CCCL (Thrust, CUB, libcudacxx), cuda-python e numba-cuda. Ti unirai al team costruendo librerie, algoritmi e infrastrutture linguistiche/runtime che rendono CUDA un'esperienza di velocità di luce per gli sviluppatori attraverso l'apprendimento profondo, il calcolo scientifico e l'analisi dei dati!

Cosa farete:

• Sviluppare e implementare CUDA Core Libraries in C++ e/o Python, inclusi algoritmi paralleli e binding linguistici idiomatici per la funzionalità core CUDA.

• Componi, ottimizza ed evolgi algoritmi e API GPU, dalle interfacce di alto livello fino a sintonizzazione delle prestazioni di basso livello che coinvolgono memoria, parallelismo e sincronizzazione.

• Caratteristiche proprie end-to-end: sviluppare, implementare, testare, benchmarking, documentazione e manutenzione a lungo termine.

• Migliorare l'esperienza degli sviluppatori attraverso lo stack: CI, test, benchmark, imballaggio, esempi e doc.

• Collabora con gli ingegneri CUDA senior in recensioni di progettazione, recensioni di codice e flussi di lavoro open-source-style.

• Coinvolgere con utenti reali attraverso problemi, indagini sulle prestazioni e feedback API.

Cosa dobbiamo vedere:

• BS, MS, o PhD in Informatica, Ingegneria Informatica, o un campo o un'esperienza equivalente.

• Minimo di 8+ anni di esperienza relativa allo sviluppo

• Forte capacità di programmazione in C++, Python, o entrambi, con comprovato interesse nel software di livello di sistemi (performance, memoria, convalutazione, progettazione API).

• Solida comprensione del C++ moderno (templati, generici, libreria standard) e/o sviluppo e imballaggio di libreria Python.

• Esperienza pratica con programmazione parallela o eterogenea (CUDA, OpenMP, GPU-accelerated Python, o simile).

• Esperienza contribuendo a software di produzione o librerie open source, tra cui test, profilazione e revisione del codice.

• Capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente, problemi di portata e guidare i progetti al completamento.

• Comunicazione scritta chiara per la progettazione tecnica e la documentazione.

• Comfort navigando grandi codebases multilingua (C++, Python, CMake, Pixi, CI systems).

Modi per distinguersi dalla folla:

• Forte comprensione dell'architettura CPU/GPU e come i dettagli hardware influiscono sulle prestazioni.

• Esperienza pratica con CUDA C++, CUDA Python, PyTorch, JAX, Numba, CuPy, o simili stack di accesso alla GPU.

• Familiarità con Thrust, CUB, libcudacxx o altre moderne librerie C++/GPU.

• Esperienza con l'infrastruttura di compilatore o utensili (LLVM, Clang tooling, MLIR).

• Demonstrated interesse per gli strumenti di sviluppo, la progettazione della biblioteca, e rendere altri sviluppatori più veloce.

Se vi preoccupate molto delle prestazioni, godetevi di lavorare al confine C++/Python, e volete modellare le librerie CUDA core basate su migliaia di sviluppatori, questo ruolo è una vestibilità diretta.

Il tuo stipendio base sarà determinato in base alla tua posizione, esperienza e la paga dei dipendenti in posizioni simili. Per la Polonia: la gamma di stipendio base è 292,500 PLN - 507,000 PLN per il livello 4, e 375.000 PLN - 650.000 PLN per il livello 5.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Die beschleunigte Rechenplattform von NVIDIA ist die Grundlage für moderne HPC und KI. Kernstück dieser Plattform sind die CUDA Core Libraries. C++- und Python-Bibliotheken, die es Entwicklern ermöglichen, schnelle, zuverlässige und skalierbare GPU-beschleunigte Software zu schreiben! Wir stellen einen Vollzeit-Software-Ingenieur ein, der an den CUDA Core Libraries arbeitet, die GPU-Computing für C++- und Python-Entwickler betreiben. Dazu gehören Projekte wie CCCL (Thrust, CUB, libcudacxx), cuda-python und numba-cuda. Sie werden dem Team beitreten, das die grundlegenden Bibliotheken, Algorithmen und Sprach-/Runtime-Infrastruktur aufbaut, die CUDA zu einem Speed-of-Light-Erlebnis für Entwickler in den Bereichen Deep Learning, Scientific Computing und Data Analytics machen!

Was du tun wirst:

• Entwicklung und Implementierung von CUDA Core Libraries in C++ und/oder Python, einschließlich paralleler Algorithmen und idiomatischer Sprachbindungen für die Kernfunktionalität von CUDA.

• Verfassen, optimieren und entwickeln Sie GPU-Algorithmen und APIs, von High-Level-Schnittstellen bis hin zu Low-Level-Performance-Tuning mit Speicher, Parallelität und Synchronisation.

• Eigene Funktionen: Entwicklung, Implementierung, Test, Benchmarking, Dokumentation und langfristige Wartung.

• Verbessern Sie die Entwicklererfahrung über den gesamten Stapel: CI, Tests, Benchmarks, Verpackungen, Beispiele und Dokumente.

• Arbeiten Sie mit leitenden CUDA-Ingenieuren bei Design-Reviews, Code-Reviews und Open-Source-Workflows zusammen.

• Engagieren Sie sich mit echten Benutzern durch Probleme, Leistungsuntersuchungen und API-Feedback.

Was wir sehen müssen:

• BS, MS oder PhD in Informatik, Computer Engineering oder einem verwandten Bereich oder gleichwertige Erfahrung.

• Mindestens 8+ Jahre einschlägige Entwicklungserfahrung

• Starke Programmierkenntnisse in C++, Python oder beidem, mit nachgewiesenem Interesse an Software auf Systemebene (Leistung, Speicher, Parallelität, API-Design).

• Solides Verständnis der modernen C++ (Vorlagen, Generika, Standardbibliothek) und / oder Python-Bibliothek Entwicklung und Verpackung.

• Praktische Erfahrung mit paralleler oder heterogener Programmierung (CUDA, OpenMP, GPU-beschleunigtes Python oder ähnliches).

• Erfahrung als Beitrag zu Produktionssoftware oder Open-Source-Bibliotheken, einschließlich Testen, Profiling und Code-Review.

• Fähigkeit, unabhängig zu arbeiten, Umfangsprobleme zu lösen und Projekte bis zum Abschluss zu bringen.

• Klare schriftliche Kommunikation für technische Gestaltung und Dokumentation.

• Komfort navigieren durch große, mehrsprachige Codebasen (C++, Python, CMake, Pixi, CI-Systeme).

Möglichkeiten, sich von der Masse abzuheben:

• Starkes Verständnis der CPU/GPU-Architektur und wie Hardware-Details die Leistung beeinflussen.

• Praktische Erfahrung mit CUDA C++, CUDA Python, PyTorch, JAX, Numba, CuPy oder ähnlichen GPU-beschleunigten Stacks.

• Vertrautheit mit Thrust, CUB, libcudacxx oder anderen modernen C++/GPU-Bibliotheken.

• Erfahrung mit Compiler-Infrastruktur oder Tooling (LLVM, Clang Tooling, MLIR).

• Demonstriertes Interesse an Entwicklertools, Bibliotheksdesign und der Beschleunigung anderer Entwickler.

Wenn Sie sich für Leistung interessieren, Spaß an der C++ / Python-Grenze haben und die Kernbibliotheken von CUDA, auf die sich Tausende von Entwicklern verlassen, gestalten möchten, passt diese Rolle direkt dazu.

Ihr Grundgehalt wird basierend auf Ihrem Standort, Ihrer Erfahrung und der Bezahlung von Mitarbeitern in ähnlichen Positionen festgelegt. Für Polen: Die Grundgehaltsspanne beträgt 292.500 PLN - 507.000 PLN für Level 4 und 375.000 PLN - 650.000 PLN für Level 5.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
La plate-forme de calcul accélérée NVIDIA est la base de HPC et d'IA modernes. Au cœur de cette plateforme se trouvent les bibliothèques de base CUDA. Bibliothèques C++ et Python qui permettent aux développeurs d'écrire des logiciels accélérés GPU rapides, fiables et évolutives ! Nous recrutons un ingénieur logiciel à temps plein pour travailler sur les bibliothèques de base CUDA qui alimentent le calcul GPU pour les développeurs C++ et Python. Cela comprend des projets comme la CCCL (Thrust, CUB, libcudacxx), le cuda-python et la numba-cuda. Vous vous joindrez à l'équipe qui construit les bibliothèques fondamentales, les algorithmes et l'infrastructure langagière/runtime qui font de CUDA une expérience de vitesse de lumière pour les développeurs à travers l'apprentissage profond, l'informatique scientifique et l'analyse de données !

Ce que vous allez faire:

• Développez et implémentez CUDA Core Libraries en C++ et/ou Python, y compris des algorithmes parallèles et des liaisons de langage idiomatique pour la fonctionnalité CUDA de base.

• Composez, optimisez et évoluez des algorithmes GPU et des API, depuis les interfaces de haut niveau jusqu'au réglage de faible performance impliquant la mémoire, le parallélisme et la synchronisation.

• Caractéristiques propres : développement, mise en oeuvre, essais, benchmarking, documentation et maintenance à long terme.

• Améliorer l'expérience du développeur à travers la pile : CI, tests, repères, emballages, exemples et docs.

• Collaborer avec des ingénieurs seniors du CUDA dans les examens de conception, les examens de code et les workflows de style open-source.

• S'engager auprès des utilisateurs réels au moyen de problèmes, d'enquêtes de performance et de rétroaction sur l'API.

Ce que nous devons voir :

• BS, MS ou doctorat en informatique, génie informatique, ou un domaine connexe ou une expérience équivalente.

• Au moins 8 ans d'expérience de développement connexe

• Fortes compétences en programmation en C++, Python, ou les deux, avec un intérêt prouvé pour les logiciels de niveau système (performance, mémoire, concurrence, conception d'API).

• Compréhension solide du C++ moderne (templates, génériques, bibliothèque standard) et/ou du développement et de l'emballage des bibliothèques Python.

• Expérience pratique avec la programmation parallèle ou hétérogène (CUDA, OpenMP, Python accéléré GPU, ou similaire).

• Expérience de la contribution aux logiciels de production ou aux bibliothèques libres, y compris les tests, le profilage et l'examen des codes.

• Capacité de travailler de façon indépendante, d'étendre les problèmes et de mener les projets à leur terme.

• Communication écrite claire pour la conception technique et la documentation.

• Confort de navigation de grandes bases de codes multilingues (C++, Python, CMake, Pixi, systèmes CI).

Comment se démarquer de la foule :

• Une bonne compréhension de l'architecture CPU/GPU et de la façon dont les détails matériels affectent les performances.

• Expérience pratique avec CUDA C++, CUDA Python, PyTorch, JAX, Numba, CuPy ou des piles accélérées GPU similaires.

• Familiarité avec Thrust, CUB, libcudacxx ou d'autres bibliothèques modernes C++/GPU.

• Expérience de l'infrastructure du compilateur ou de l'outillage (LLVM, outillage Clang, MLIR).

• L'intérêt manifesté pour les outils de développement, la conception de la bibliothèque, et de rendre les autres développeurs plus rapides.

Si vous vous souciez profondément des performances, si vous aimez travailler à la frontière C++/Python, et si vous voulez façonner les bibliothèques CUDA de base sur lesquelles comptent des milliers de développeurs, ce rôle est un ajustement direct.

Votre salaire de base sera déterminé en fonction de votre emplacement, de votre expérience et de la rémunération des employés occupant des postes semblables. Pour la Pologne : L'échelle salariale de base est de 292 500 PLN - 507 000 PLN pour le niveau 4, et de 375 000 PLN - 650 000 PLN pour le niveau 5.

jobs.title: Senior Solutions Architect, HPC and AI

titleByLocale.it: Senior Solutions Architetto, HPC and AI
titleByLocale.en: Senior Solutions Architect, HPC and AI
titleByLocale.de: Senior Solutions Architect, HPC und AI
titleByLocale.fr: Senior Solutions Architecte, HPC and AI

jobs.description:
We are seeking a Senior Solutions Architect with strong hands-on experience in deploying, debugging, and optimizing training and inference workloads on large-scale GPU clusters. As we support customers and partners across Europe in training models on ground breaking GPU infrastructure, we are looking for someone who enjoys solving complex challenges at the intersection of High Performance Computing and AI. Similarly, inference is increasing in its complexity with explosion of MOE models and disaggregated execution making inference truly a HPC workload. You don’t need to have expertise in every skill we mention, but we are especially interested in candidates who bring deep knowledge in at least few key areas to enable large scale AI workloads. If you can demonstrate hands-on experience, we would love to hear from you.

What You’ll Be Doing:

• Collaborating with NVIDIA’s training framework developers and product teams to stay ahead of the latest features and help partners to adopt them effectively.

• Assisting with deployment, debugging, and improving the efficiency of AI workloads on extensive NVIDIA platforms.

• Benchmarking new framework features, analyzing performance, and sharing actionable insights with both customers and internal teams.

• Working directly with external customers to solve cluster performance and stability issues, identify bottlenecks, and implement effective solutions.

• Build expertise and guide customers in scaling workloads efficiently and reliably on the latest generation of NVIDIA GPUs.

• Contributing to Europe’s Sovereign AI initiative by helping customers implement advanced resiliency features within AI training pipelines.

What We Need To See:

• BS, MS, PhD or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, or a related engineering field—or equivalent practical experience.

• 8+ years of experience in accelerated computing technologies at cluster scale, ideally including work with NVIDIA platforms.

• Strong programming skills in at least one of the following languages: C, C++, or Python.

• Practical experience identifying and resolving bottlenecks in large-scale training workloads or parallel applications.

• Hands-on experienced in profiling and debugging large parallel applications.

• Solid understanding of CPU and GPU architectures, CUDA, parallel filesystems, and high-speed interconnects.

• Experienced in working with large compute clusters with an understanding of their internal scheduling and resource management mechanisms (e.g. SLURM or Cloud based clusters).

• Proficient knowledge of training pipelines and frameworks, encompassing their internal operations and performance attributes.

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd:

• Experience in debugging training pipelines running on thousands of GPUs in production environment.

• Hands-on experience with performance profiling and optimizations using tools like Nsight Systems, Nsight Compute and good understanding of NCCL, MPI and low-level communication libraries.

• Ability to debug stability issues across the entire stack: parallel application, training frameworks, runtime libraries, schedulers, and hardware.

• Solid understanding of the internal workings of LLM frameworks such as PyTorch, Megatron-LM, or NeMo, and how they affect compute layers like CPUs, GPUs, network and storage or understanding of inference tools such as vLLM, Dynamo, TensorRT-LLM, RedHat Inference Server or SGLang.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Siamo alla ricerca di un Senior Solutions Architect con una forte esperienza pratica nella distribuzione, nel debug e nell'ottimizzazione dei carichi di lavoro di formazione e inferenza su cluster GPU su larga scala. Mentre sosteniamo clienti e partner in tutta Europa nella formazione di modelli su infrastrutture GPU a terra, stiamo cercando qualcuno che si diverte a risolvere sfide complesse all'incrocio di High Performance Computing e AI. Allo stesso modo, l'inferenza aumenta nella sua complessità con l'esplosione di modelli MOE e l'esecuzione disaggregated rendendo l'inferenza veramente un carico di lavoro HPC. Non c'è bisogno di avere esperienza in ogni abilità che citiamo, ma siamo particolarmente interessati a candidati che portano conoscenza profonda in almeno poche aree chiave per consentire carichi di lavoro AI su larga scala. Se si può dimostrare esperienza pratica, ci piacerebbe sentire da voi.

Cosa farai:

• Collaborando con gli sviluppatori di framework di formazione di NVIDIA e con i team di prodotti per stare al passo con le ultime funzionalità e aiutare i partner ad adottarli in modo efficace.

• Assistere con distribuzione, debug e migliorare l'efficienza dei carichi di lavoro AI su ampie piattaforme NVIDIA.

• Benchmarking nuove funzionalità di framework, analizzando le prestazioni e condividendo intuizioni attuabili con clienti e team interni.

• Lavorare direttamente con i clienti esterni per risolvere i problemi di prestazioni e stabilità dei cluster, identificare i colli di bottiglia e implementare soluzioni efficaci.

• Costruire competenze e guidare i clienti nella scalatura dei carichi di lavoro in modo efficiente e affidabile sull'ultima generazione di GPU NVIDIA.

• Contribuire all’iniziativa Europa per l’AI Sovrana, aiutando i clienti a implementare funzionalità avanzate di resilienza all’interno delle pipeline di formazione AI.

Cosa dobbiamo vedere:

• BS, MS, PhD o equivalente esperienza in Informatica, Ingegneria Elettrica/Computer, Fisica, Matematica, o un campo di ingegneria correlato—o esperienza pratica equivalente.

• 8+ anni di esperienza nelle tecnologie di calcolo accelerate a scala di cluster, idealmente compreso il lavoro con le piattaforme NVIDIA.

• Forte capacità di programmazione in almeno una delle seguenti lingue: C, C++ o Python.

• Esperienza pratica che identifica e risolve i colli di bottiglia in carichi di lavoro di formazione su larga scala o applicazioni parallele.

• Hands-on sperimentato nella profilazione e debug di grandi applicazioni parallele.

• Solida comprensione delle architetture CPU e GPU, CUDA, filesystem paralleli e interconnessioni ad alta velocità.

• Esperienza nel lavorare con grandi cluster di calcolo con una comprensione dei loro meccanismi di pianificazione interna e di gestione delle risorse (ad esempio cluster basati su SLURM o Cloud).

• Conoscenza competente delle linee di formazione e dei quadri, che comprendono le loro operazioni interne e gli attributi delle prestazioni.

Modi per uscire dalla folla:

• Esperienza nel debug delle pipeline di formazione in esecuzione su migliaia di GPU in ambiente di produzione.

• Esperienza pratica con la profilazione delle prestazioni e ottimizzazioni utilizzando strumenti come Nsight Systems, Nsight Compute e una buona comprensione di NCCL, MPI e librerie di comunicazione di basso livello.
