descriptionByLocale.en:
We are seeking a Senior Solutions Architect with strong hands-on experience in deploying, debugging, and optimizing training and inference workloads on large-scale GPU clusters. As we support customers and partners across Europe in training models on ground breaking GPU infrastructure, we are looking for someone who enjoys solving complex challenges at the intersection of High Performance Computing and AI. Similarly, inference is increasing in its complexity with explosion of MOE models and disaggregated execution making inference truly a HPC workload. You don’t need to have expertise in every skill we mention, but we are especially interested in candidates who bring deep knowledge in at least few key areas to enable large scale AI workloads. If you can demonstrate hands-on experience, we would love to hear from you.

What You’ll Be Doing:

• Collaborating with NVIDIA’s training framework developers and product teams to stay ahead of the latest features and help partners to adopt them effectively.

• Assisting with deployment, debugging, and improving the efficiency of AI workloads on extensive NVIDIA platforms.

• Benchmarking new framework features, analyzing performance, and sharing actionable insights with both customers and internal teams.

• Working directly with external customers to solve cluster performance and stability issues, identify bottlenecks, and implement effective solutions.

• Build expertise and guide customers in scaling workloads efficiently and reliably on the latest generation of NVIDIA GPUs.

• Contributing to Europe’s Sovereign AI initiative by helping customers implement advanced resiliency features within AI training pipelines.

What We Need To See:

• BS, MS, PhD or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, or a related engineering field—or equivalent practical experience.

• 8+ years of experience in accelerated computing technologies at cluster scale, ideally including work with NVIDIA platforms.

• Strong programming skills in at least one of the following languages: C, C++, or Python.

• Practical experience identifying and resolving bottlenecks in large-scale training workloads or parallel applications.

• Hands-on experienced in profiling and debugging large parallel applications.

• Solid understanding of CPU and GPU architectures, CUDA, parallel filesystems, and high-speed interconnects.

• Experienced in working with large compute clusters with an understanding of their internal scheduling and resource management mechanisms (e.g. SLURM or Cloud based clusters).

• Proficient knowledge of training pipelines and frameworks, encompassing their internal operations and performance attributes.

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd:

• Experience in debugging training pipelines running on thousands of GPUs in production environment.

• Hands-on experience with performance profiling and optimizations using tools like Nsight Systems, Nsight Compute and good understanding of NCCL, MPI and low-level communication libraries.

• Ability to debug stability issues across the entire stack: parallel application, training frameworks, runtime libraries, schedulers, and hardware.

• Solid understanding of the internal workings of LLM frameworks such as PyTorch, Megatron-LM, or NeMo, and how they affect compute layers like CPUs, GPUs, network and storage or understanding of inference tools such as vLLM, Dynamo, TensorRT-LLM, RedHat Inference Server or SGLang.
descriptionByLocale.de:

descriptionByLocale.fr:

jobs.title: Senior Performance Engineer
jobs.description:
NVIDIA is seeking a highly skilled Senior Performance Engineer to join our Performance and R&D organizations. In this role, you will help build and evolve systems that support performance analysis, telemetry, and optimization for large-scale GPU- and CPU-based clusters used in AI and high-performance computing environments. You will work closely with hardware, networking, firmware, and software teams to collect, analyze, and interpret performance data from live systems. This is a fast-paced R&D environment where system behavior and requirements evolve rapidly, requiring adaptable engineering solutions and strong analytical thinking.

What you’ll be doing:

• Profile, benchmark, and analyze AI and HPC workloads on GPU and CPU clusters

• Explore performance characteristics of high-performance networking and collective communications (e.g., NCCL, RDMA, MPI, RoCE)

• Identify performance bottlenecks across networking, compute, memory, and system architecture

• Develop and enhance performance analysis, benchmarking, and diagnostic tools

• Define performance test plans and establish expectations for new technologies and platforms

• Collaborate across hardware, firmware, networking, systems, and software teams to provide actionable performance insights

• Support telemetry collection and data refinement efforts to enable accurate performance analysis

• Maintain high standards for data quality, reproducibility, and traceability of performance results

What we need to see:

• B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience

• 5+ years of experience in performance analysis, systems engineering, or HPC/AI infrastructure

• Demonstrated expertise in performance analysis skills and methodologies

• Hands-on experience with high-performance networking (RDMA, MPI, NCCL, congestion control)

• Strong understanding of system performance metrics (latency, throughput, resource utilization)

• Exposure to hardware, firmware, or embedded telemetry environments

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills

• Ability to work effectively in cross-functional, fast-paced R&D teams

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

• Knowledge of CUDA, NCCL internals, and congestion control algorithms

• Deep system-level understanding of CPU architectures, GPUs, HCAs, memory, and PCIe

• Experience with NVIDIA GPUs, CUDA, and deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow

• Experience with cloud platforms

• Proficiency in Python; experience with Bash and C/C++ is a plus as well as a strong experience working in Linux environments

At NVIDIA, we are passionate about supercomputing and powerful ground-breaking technologies. Our products span many areas, such as: high-performance computing (HPC), Machine Learning, cloud services, storage and more - and we've only scratched the surface of what can be accomplished. We need hardworking and creative people to help us seek some of these outstanding opportunities. With highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package, NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the smartest engineers in the world working for us and, due to extraordinary growth, our elite engineering teams are fast-growing fast. If you're a creative and autonomous manager with a sincere passion for technology, we want to hear from you.

NVIDIA is committed to fostering a diverse work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.

A NVIDIA, siamo appassionati di supercomputing e potenti tecnologie innovative. Abbiamo bisogno di persone laboriose e creative per aiutarci a cercare alcune di queste opportunità eccezionali. Con salari altamente competitivi e un pacchetto completo di benefici, NVIDIA è ampiamente considerato uno dei datori di lavoro più desiderabili del mondo tecnologico. Abbiamo alcuni degli ingegneri più intelligenti del mondo che lavorano per noi e, a causa di una crescita straordinaria, i nostri team di ingegneria d'élite sono in rapida crescita. Se sei un manager creativo e autonomo con una passione sincera per la tecnologia, vogliamo sentire da te.

NVIDIA si impegna a promuovere un ambiente di lavoro diverso e orgoglioso di essere un datore di lavoro pari opportunità. Poiché apprezziamo molto la diversità nei nostri dipendenti, non discrimina (anche nelle nostre pratiche di assunzione e promozione) sulla base di razza, religione, colore, origine nazionale, sesso, espressione di genere, orientamento sessuale, età, stato civile, stato veterano, stato di disabilità o qualsiasi altra caratteristica protetta dalla legge.

• Explorer les caractéristiques de rendement des réseaux à haut rendement et des communications collectives (p. ex., CCNL, RDMA, MPI, RoCE)

• Identifier les goulets d'étranglement de performance dans l'architecture de réseau, de calcul, de mémoire et de système

• Élaborer et améliorer les outils d'analyse du rendement, d'analyse comparative et de diagnostic

• Définir des plans de tests de performance et établir des attentes pour les nouvelles technologies et plateformes

• Collaborer avec les équipes du matériel, du firmware, du réseautage, des systèmes et des logiciels afin de fournir des informations pratiques sur les performances

• Appuyer les efforts de collecte de télémétrie et d'amélioration des données pour permettre une analyse précise des performances

• Maintenir des normes élevées de qualité des données, de reproductibilité et de traçabilité des résultats de performance

Ce que nous devons voir :

• B.Sc. ou M.Sc. en informatique, génie informatique, génie logiciel ou expérience équivalente

• 5+ ans d'expérience en analyse de performance, en ingénierie de systèmes ou en infrastructure HPC/AI

• Compétences et méthodologies démontrées en analyse des performances

• Expérience pratique avec le réseau haute performance (RDMA, MPI, NCCL, contrôle de la congestion)

• Connaissance approfondie des paramètres de performance du système (latence, débit, utilisation des ressources)

• Exposition à des environnements de matériel, de firmware ou de télémétrie embarqués

• Forte capacité d'analyse, de résolution de problèmes et de communication

• Capacité de travailler efficacement dans des équipes de R-D interfonctionnelles et rapides

Comment se démarquer de la foule :

• Connaissance des algorithmes CUDA, NCCL et de contrôle de la congestion

• Compréhension profonde au niveau du système des architectures CPU, GPU, HCA, mémoire et PCIe

• Expérience avec les GPU NVIDIA, les CUDA et les cadres d'apprentissage profond tels que PyTorch ou TensorFlow

• Expérience avec les plateformes cloud

• La compétence en Python ; l'expérience avec Bash et C/C++ est un plus ainsi qu'une solide expérience de travail dans les environnements Linux

Chez NVIDIA, nous sommes passionnés par la superinformatique et les technologies révolutionnaires puissantes. Nos produits couvrent de nombreux domaines, tels que l'informatique haute performance (HPC), le Machine Learning, les services cloud, le stockage et bien plus encore. Nous avons besoin de gens travailleurs et créatifs pour nous aider à trouver certaines de ces possibilités exceptionnelles. Avec des salaires très compétitifs et un ensemble complet d'avantages sociaux, NVIDIA est largement considéré comme l'un des employeurs les plus souhaitables du monde de la technologie. Nous avons quelques-uns des ingénieurs les plus intelligents du monde qui travaillent pour nous et, grâce à une croissance extraordinaire, nos équipes d'ingénieurs d'élite connaissent une croissance rapide. Si vous êtes un manager créatif et autonome avec une passion sincère pour la technologie, nous voulons entendre de vous.

La NVIDIA s'est engagée à favoriser un milieu de travail diversifié et est fière d'être un employeur à chances égales. Étant donné que nous accordons une grande valeur à la diversité de nos employés, nous ne faisons aucune discrimination (y compris dans nos pratiques d'embauche et de promotion) en raison de la race, de la religion, de la couleur, de l'origine nationale, du sexe, de l'expression du sexe, de l'orientation sexuelle, de l'âge, de l'état matrimonial, du statut d'ancien combattant, du statut d'invalidité ou de toute autre caractéristique protégée par la loi.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Support Engineer, Network
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Senior Network Engineer to join a dynamic, results-oriented team supporting InfiniBand and Ethernet fabrics in the most demanding data center, AI, storage, and HPC environments. As a Technical Support Engineer, you will be an approachable, proficient communicator who takes ownership of resolving issues while ensuring a high level of customer satisfaction. You will work closely with Engineering, Marketing, and Support teams on complex technical issues.

What you will be doing:

• Tier 3 support for InfiniBand and Ethernet fabrics: installing, supporting, and resolving complex technical issues in large AI/HPC and storage clusters

• Troubleshooting end-to-end InfiniBand fabrics — subnet management (UFM / OpenSM), routing topology and congestion control.

• Developing and presenting comprehensive technical solutions to customer problems, including project management of complex fabric installations

• Problem reporting, issue replication, and resolution management

• Responding to customer technical inquiries

• Site visits and conference calls with customers and partners

• Developing and refining internal processes to improve support efficiency and productivity

What we need to see:

• B.Sc. in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or Electrical Engineering, or equivalent experience

• 5+ years providing customer support for hardware & software products

• Hands-on InfiniBand experience — OR deep Ethernet/RDMA expertise with a demonstrated ability and strong motivation to ramp quickly on InfiniBand (subnet manager, fabric topologies such as fat-tree, RDMA verbs, diagnostics)

• Extensive knowledge of LAN switching/routing (STP, MSTP, MLAG, VPC, VRRP, LACP) and IP routing (OSPF, BGP, PIM), plus virtualization, EVPN, VXLAN

• Linux experience and scripting

• Automation — Ansible

• Ability to work under pressure and support high-level customers

• Experience operating and configuring major vendors' switches and routers

• Analysis and diagnosis of highly complex networking problems

• Strong communication, presentation, and oral skills; excellent verbal and written English

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

• Deep InfiniBand expertise: UFM, OpenSM, adaptive routing, congestion control, link-layer troubleshooting, ibdiagnet/perftest, ConnectX/BlueField adapters

• RDMA, RoCE, and GPUDirect RDMA in production AI/HPC clusters

• Clustering and data-center technologies, including upper-layer protocols (e.g., MPI, NCCL)

• Knowledge of Linux/Unix at an administration level

• Ethernet (10/40/100+ GigE) and/or InfiniBand at scale

​
NVIDIA is widely considered one of the technology world's most desirable employers, with some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people anywhere. If you're creative, results-oriented, and enjoy having fun — what are you waiting for? Apply today!

• Tecnologie di clustering e data-center, compresi i protocolli ad alto livello (ad esempio, MPI, NCCL)

• Ethernet (10/40/100+ GigE) e/o InfiniBand su scala

jobs.description:
NVIDIA is the engine of modern artificial intelligence, the biggest technology breakthrough of our time, and is transforming the healthcare industry. NVIDIA accelerated computing platform and services are providing intangible capabilities to reimagine the pharmaceutical industry. Accelerating the drug discovery process and delivering on the potential of digital biology and protein engineering with data science, an invaluable contribution to critically important to global society. We are looking for an Enterprise Sales Account Manager – HCLS DACH to grow adoption of our ground-breaking cloud and data centre solutions required to realize R&D and business transformation across the pharmaceutical, genomics and life sciences industry.

Your mission is to drive the growth of NVIDIA revenue with global pharma and biotech companies. Build Healthcare specific solutions based on NVIDIA hardware and software stacks, in collaboration with ISV and partner ecosystem. This is a highly visible role, which will work closely with the cross functional teams at NVIDIA to drive growth and will be accountable to establish NVIDIA’s leadership in this segment and build and execute the plan for the associated revenue and pipeline growth. The role requires strong leadership skills along with ability to execute and contribute towards the delivery of sales results. It requires strong domain expertise in segment with executive relationships. Collaborate closely with senior business development, product and sales to drive alignment and build pipeline to expand NVIDIA’s revenue. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced dynamic environment and enjoys the challenges that rapid growth creates. A consistent record of leadership in an impactful sales/business development organization is required.

What you’ll be doing:

• Design, build and execute the revenue strategy within the healthcare and life sciences ecosystem.

• Collaborate closely with product teams to develop and package healthcare specific solutions.

• Develop a successful partnership with the pharma, biotech and life science organizations outlining mutual performance objectives, targets, and breakthroughs associated with a successful relationship.

• Lead and support sales execution in partnership with our regional sales teams. Discover, develop and nurture key customers relationships/Light House Accounts.

• Engage, enable, and energize channel sales teams including global system integrators, public cloud service providers to deliver joint go-to-market initiatives in a win-win-win situation.

• Support sales critical issues, partner/channel conflicts and related business issues.

What we need to see:

• Bachelor’s degree from a leading University or equivalent experience.

• 8+ overall years of sales or business development experience in pharmaceutical, genomics and life sciences technology with demonstrated ability running an overlay sales organization.

• Deep understanding of applications and workflows bringing to bear Machine Learning, Deep Learning and AI.

• Strong relationships in the pharmaceutical and biotechnology ecosystem.

• Demonstrated experience with sell-to and sell-through the healthcare life science ecosystem

• Possess a DACH client contact base, deep domain expertise, and sales and buying practices.

• Shown success of building positive partnerships with large organizations.

• Consistent track record of sales execution overachievement.

• Confirmed ability to work effectively in highly matrixed organization.

• Experience with leading and closing sophisticated deal negotiations and alliances.

• Knowledge of enterprise computing software and services pricing strategies, channel economics, and hybrid computing platforms both on-prem and cloud offerings

• Relevant experience related to global partnerships and establishing joint sales models and metrics.

jobs.title: Senior Software Developer, AI Networking
jobs.description:
NVIDIA is changing the world of AI Networking with groundbreaking technology. We are excited to be adding an AI Networking Software Developer to our AI Networking SW development and codesign team. We are working with the latest NVIDIA hardware and technologies. We do full stack benchmarking for Data Center scale systems for AI training/inference and lower level benchmarks. We strive for automation and develop many tools in-house yet adopt community accepted practices and frameworks. Moreover we give back to community developing our own tools in public GitHub repositories. Our goal is to ensure that large-scale systems deliver expected performance in practice, not just on paper, by uncovering bottlenecks and driving continuous improvements.

What you'll be doing :

• Developing AI networking communication frameworks and applications running in production on the world’s largest supercomputers and data centers.

• Develop production tools and benchmarks used by multiple teams inside and outside NVIDIA.

• Enable new AI models within our benchmarking infrastructure and deliver insights through end-to-end analysis of large-scale workloads across hardware and software stacks.

• Design and implement automation systems, including large-scale parameter search to identify optimal configurations across complex systems.

• Collaborate closely with networking and hardware teams to co-design new features and software interfaces in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

What we need to see:

• B.Sc., M.Sc degree in Computer Science / Software engineering, and 5+ years or equivalent experience.

• Professional Python development experience. We seek individuals who build maintainable, long-lived tools that do not impose a heavy burden on the team in terms of maintenance.

• Solid Linux expertise and passion for working extensively in command-line environments.

• Ability to work across a broad and evolving stack, with a strong drive to learn—from hardware and networking up to large-scale AI systems running across entire clusters

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

• Knowledge and/or experience with modern AI ecosystem: PyTorch, LLMs, inference and training.

• Familiarity with cluster orchestration systems such as Slurm or Kubernetes.

• Knowledge in MPI and HPC, InfiniBand, Ethernet and Networking.

• Experience in performance optimizations

For two decades, we have pioneered visual computing, and the art and science of computer graphics. With our invention of the GPU - the engine of modern visual computing - the field has expanded to encompass video games, movie production, product design, medical diagnosis and scientific research. Today, we stand at the beginning of the next era, the AI computing era, ignited by a new computing model, GPU deep learning. This new model - where deep neural networks are trained to recognize patterns from massive amounts of data - has shown to be deeply effective at solving some of the most complex problems in everyday life. NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world's most desirable companies to work for. Are you creative and driven? Do you love a challenge? If so, we want to hear from you.

descriptionByLocale.it:
NVIDIA sta cambiando il mondo di AI Networking con la tecnologia innovativa. Siamo entusiasti di aggiungere un AI Networking Software Developer al nostro team di sviluppo e codesign di AI Networking SW. Lavoriamo con le ultime tecnologie e hardware NVIDIA. Facciamo il benchmarking a stack completo per i sistemi di scala Data Center per la formazione/l'inferenza di AI e i benchmark di livello inferiore. Ci sforziamo di automazione e sviluppiamo molti strumenti in-house ancora adottare le pratiche e le strutture accettate dalla comunità. Inoltre ridiamo alla comunità sviluppando i nostri strumenti nei repository GitHub pubblici. Il nostro obiettivo è quello di garantire che i sistemi su larga scala offrono prestazioni attesi in pratica, non solo su carta, scoprendo strozzature e guidando miglioramenti continui.

Cosa farai?

• Sviluppare framework di comunicazione di rete AI e applicazioni in esecuzione in produzione sui più grandi supercomputer e data center del mondo.

• Sviluppare strumenti di produzione e benchmark utilizzati da più team all'interno e all'esterno di NVIDIA.

• Abilitare nuovi modelli AI all'interno della nostra infrastruttura di benchmarking e fornire informazioni attraverso l'analisi end-to-end di carichi di lavoro su larga scala attraverso stack hardware e software.

• Progettazione e realizzazione di sistemi di automazione, tra cui ricerca di parametri su larga scala per identificare configurazioni ottimali in sistemi complessi.

• Collabora a stretto contatto con team di networking e hardware per co-disegnare nuove funzionalità e interfacce software in un ambiente in rapida evoluzione.

Cosa dobbiamo vedere:

• Laurea, laurea in Informatica / ingegneria del software, e 5+ anni o esperienza equivalente.

• Esperienza di sviluppo professionale Python. Cerchiamo persone che costruiscono strumenti manutenbili e di lunga durata che non impongono un pesante carico al team in termini di manutenzione.

• Competenze e passione di Linux solide per lavorare in ambienti di linea di comando.

• Capacità di lavorare su uno stack ampio e in evoluzione, con un forte impulso da imparare, dall'hardware e dalla rete fino a sistemi AI su larga scala in esecuzione su interi cluster

Modi per distinguersi dalla folla:

• Conoscenza e/o esperienza con il moderno ecosistema AI: PyTorch, LLMs, inferenza e formazione.

• Familiarità con sistemi di orchestrazione a grappolo come Slurm o Kubernetes.

• Conoscenza in MPI e HPC, InfiniBand, Ethernet e Networking.

• Esperienza nelle ottimizzazioni delle prestazioni

Per due decenni, abbiamo pionieristico calcolo visivo, e l'arte e la scienza della grafica del computer. Con la nostra invenzione della GPU - il motore del moderno calcolo visivo - il campo si è ampliato per comprendere videogiochi, produzione di film, product design, diagnosi medica e ricerca scientifica. Oggi, siamo all'inizio della prossima era, l'era informatica AI, accesi da un nuovo modello di calcolo, GPU deep learning. Questo nuovo modello - dove le reti neurali profonde sono addestrate a riconoscere modelli da quantità massiccia di dati - ha dimostrato di essere profondamente efficace nella soluzione di alcuni dei problemi più complessi nella vita quotidiana. NVIDIA è ampiamente considerato una delle aziende più desiderabili del mondo tecnologico per cui lavorare. Sei creativo e guidato? Ti piace una sfida? Se è così, vogliamo sentire da voi.

NVIDIA transforme le monde de l'IA Networking avec une technologie révolutionnaire. • Développer les cadres de communication en réseau AI et les applications en cours de production sur les plus grands superordinateurs et centres de données du monde.

• Élaborer des outils de production et des repères utilisés par plusieurs équipes à l'intérieur et à l'extérieur de NVIDIA.

• Activer de nouveaux modèles d'IA dans notre infrastructure de benchmarking et fournir des informations grâce à une analyse de bout en bout des charges de travail à grande échelle dans les piles de matériel et de logiciels.

• Concevoir et mettre en œuvre des systèmes d'automatisation, y compris la recherche de paramètres à grande échelle pour identifier les configurations optimales à travers des systèmes complexes.

• Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes de réseautage et de matériel pour co-concevoir de nouvelles fonctionnalités et interfaces logicielles dans un environnement en évolution rapide.

Ce que nous devons voir :

• B.Sc., M.Sc. en informatique / génie logiciel, et 5+ ans ou expérience équivalente.

• Expérience professionnelle de développement Python. Nous cherchons des personnes qui construisent des outils durables et durables qui n'imposent pas un lourd fardeau à l'équipe en termes d'entretien.

• L'expertise solide de Linux et la passion pour travailler largement dans des environnements en ligne de commande.

• Capacité de travailler sur une pile large et évolutive, avec un puissant effort d'apprentissage — du matériel et de la mise en réseau jusqu'aux systèmes d'IA à grande échelle fonctionnant sur des grappes entières

Des façons de se démarquer de la foule :

• Connaissance et/ou expérience de l'écosystème moderne de l'IA : PyTorch, LLM, inférence et formation.

• Familiarité avec les systèmes d'orchestration en grappe tels que Slurm ou Kubernetes.

• Connaissances en MPI et HPC, InfiniBand, Ethernet et réseau.

• Expérience dans les optimisations de performance

Depuis deux décennies, nous sommes pionniers de l'informatique visuelle et de l'art et de la science de l'informatique graphique. Avec notre invention du GPU - le moteur de l'informatique visuelle moderne - le domaine s'est élargi pour englober les jeux vidéo, la production de films, la conception de produits, le diagnostic médical et la recherche scientifique. Aujourd'hui, nous sommes au début de l'ère suivante, l'ère informatique de l'IA, enflammée par un nouveau modèle informatique, GPU deep learning. Ce nouveau modèle, où des réseaux neuraux profonds sont formés pour reconnaître les modèles à partir de quantités massives de données, s'est révélé très efficace pour résoudre certains des problèmes les plus complexes de la vie quotidienne. NVIDIA est largement considéré comme l'une des entreprises technologiques les plus souhaitables au monde pour travailler. Êtes-vous créatif et motivé ? Vous aimez les défis ? Si oui, nous voulons avoir des nouvelles de vous.

jobs.description:
NVIDIA is looking for an experienced HPC-AI Engineer to join the Networking Clusters Solutions Infrastructure team. we are focused on building supercomputers and AI clusters based on groundbreaking technologies. We are looking for an outstanding engineer, be a key player to the most exciting computing hardware and software to contribute to the latest breakthroughs in artificial intelligence and GPU computing. Provide insights on at-scale system design and tuning mechanisms for large-scale compute runs. You will work with the latest Accelerated computing and Deep Learning software and hardware platforms, and with many scientific researchers, developers, and customers to craft improved workflows and develop new, leading differentiated solutions. You will interact with HPC, OS, GPU compute, and systems specialist to architect, develop and bring up large scale performance platforms.

What you will be doing:

• Design, implement and maintain large scale HPC/AI clusters with monitoring, logging and alerting

• Manage Linux job/workload schedules and orchestration tools

• Develop and maintain continuous integration and delivery pipelines

• Develop tooling to automate deployment and management of large-scale infrastructure environments, to automate operational monitoring and alerting, and to enable self-service consumption of resources

• Deploy monitoring solutions for the servers, network and storage

• Perform troubleshooting bottom up from bare metal, operating system, software stack and application level

• Being a technical resource, develop, re-define and document standard methodologies to share with internal teams

• Support Research & Development activities and engage in POCs/POVs for future improvements

What we need to see:

• A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field and 8+ years of experience

• Knowledge of HPC and AI solution technologies from CPU’s and GPU’s to high speed interconnects and supporting software

• Experience with job scheduling workloads and orchestration tools such as Slurm, K8s

• Excellent knowledge of Windows and Linux (Redhat/CentOS and Ubuntu) networking (sockets, firewalld, iptables, wireshark, etc.) and internals, ACLs and OS level security protection and common protocols e.g. TCP, DHCP, DNS, etc.

• Experience with multiple storage solutions such as Lustre, GPFS, Weka.io. Familiarity with newer and emerging storage technologies.

• Python programming and bash scripting experience.

• Comfortable with automation and configuration management tools such as Jenkins, Ansible, Puppet/chef

• Deep knowledge of Networking Protocols like InfiniBand, Ethernet

• Deep understanding and experience with virtual systems (for example VMware, Hyper-V, KVM, or Citrix)

• Familiarity with cloud computing platforms (e.g. AWS, Azure, Google Cloud)

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

• Knowledge of CPU and/or GPU architecture

• Knowledge of Kubernetes, container related microservice technologies

• Experience with GPU-focused hardware/software (DGX, Cuda)

• Experience with RDMA (InfiniBand or RoCE) fabrics

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

Fornire informazioni sulla progettazione e i meccanismi di sintonizzazione di sistemi su larga scala per le piste di calcolo su larga scala. Potrai lavorare con le più recenti piattaforme software e hardware Accelerated computing e Deep Learning, e con molti ricercatori scientifici, sviluppatori e clienti per creare flussi di lavoro migliorati e sviluppare nuove soluzioni differenziate leader. Interagirete con HPC, OS, Compute GPU e specialisti dei sistemi per l'architettura, lo sviluppo e la creazione di piattaforme di performance su larga scala.

Cosa farai:

• Progettare, implementare e mantenere cluster HPC/AI su larga scala con monitoraggio, registrazione e allerta

• Gestire programmi di lavoro/carico Linux e strumenti di orchestrazione

• Sviluppare e mantenere l'integrazione e la distribuzione continua

• Sviluppare strumenti per automatizzare la distribuzione e la gestione di ambienti infrastrutturali su larga scala, automatizzare il monitoraggio operativo e l'avviso, e per consentire il consumo self-service di risorse

• Distribuisci soluzioni di monitoraggio per server, rete e storage

• Eseguire la risoluzione dei problemi da metallo nudo, sistema operativo, stack software e livello di applicazione

• Essendo una risorsa tecnica, sviluppare, ridefinire e documentare metodologie standard da condividere con i team interni

• Sostenere le attività di ricerca e sviluppo e impegnarsi in POC/POV per i miglioramenti futuri

Cosa dobbiamo vedere:

• Una laurea in Informatica, Ingegneria, o un campo correlato e 8+ anni di esperienza

• Conoscenza delle tecnologie di soluzioni HPC e AI da CPU e GPU a interconnessioni ad alta velocità e software di supporto

• Esperienza con i workload di pianificazione del lavoro e strumenti di orchestrazione come Slurm, K8s

• Conoscenza eccellente di Windows e Linux (Redhat/CentOS e Ubuntu) rete (sockets, firewalld, iptables, wireshark, ecc.) e interni, ACLs e protezione di sicurezza del livello OS e protocolli comuni come TCP, DHCP, DNS, ecc.

• Esperienza con molteplici soluzioni di storage come Lustre, GPFS, Weka.io. Familiarità con tecnologie di storage più recenti e emergenti.

• Python programmazione e bash scripting esperienza.

• Confortevole con strumenti di automazione e configurazione come Jenkins, Ansible, Puppet/chef

• Conoscenza profonda dei protocolli di rete come InfiniBand, Ethernet

• Profonda comprensione ed esperienza con sistemi virtuali (ad esempio VMware, Hyper-V, KVM o Citrix)

• Familiarità con piattaforme di cloud computing (ad esempio AWS, Azure, Google Cloud)

Modi per distinguersi dalla folla:

• Conoscenza dell'architettura CPU e/o GPU

• Conoscenze di Kubernetes, tecnologie di microservice relative ai container

• Esperienza con hardware/software focalizzato su GPU (DGX, Cuda)

• Esperienza con tessuti RDMA (InfiniBand o RoCE)

descriptionByLocale.de:
NVIDIA sucht einen erfahrenen HPC-AI-Ingenieur, der sich dem Networking Clusters Solutions Infrastructure-Team anschließt. Wir konzentrieren uns auf den Aufbau von Supercomputern und KI-Clustern, die auf bahnbrechenden Technologien basieren. Wir suchen einen hervorragenden Ingenieur, der ein wichtiger Akteur für die aufregendste Computerhardware und -software ist, um zu den neuesten Durchbrüchen in der künstlichen Intelligenz und im GPU-Computing beizutragen. Geben Sie Einblicke in das Systemdesign und die Abstimmungsmechanismen für groß angelegte Rechenläufe. Sie arbeiten mit den neuesten Software- und Hardwareplattformen für Accelerated Computing und Deep Learning sowie mit vielen wissenschaftlichen Forschern, Entwicklern und Kunden, um verbesserte Workflows zu erstellen und neue, führende differenzierte Lösungen zu entwickeln. Sie werden mit HPC, OS, GPU Compute und Systemspezialisten interagieren, um große Leistungsplattformen zu erstellen, zu entwickeln und zu entwickeln.

Was Sie tun werden:

• Entwerfen, Implementieren und Pflegen von groß angelegten HPC/AI-Clustern mit Überwachung, Protokollierung und Alarmierung

• Verwalten von Linux-Job- / Workload-Zeitplänen und Orchestrierungstools

• Entwicklung und Pflege von Continuous Integration und Delivery Pipelines

• Entwicklung von Tools zur Automatisierung der Bereitstellung und Verwaltung von großen Infrastrukturumgebungen, zur Automatisierung der betrieblichen Überwachung und Alarmierung und zur Ermöglichung des Selbstbedienungsverbrauchs von Ressourcen

• Bereitstellung von Überwachungslösungen für Server, Netzwerk und Speicher

• Führen Sie die Fehlerbehebung von Bottom-up aus Bare Metal, Betriebssystem, Software-Stack und Anwendungsebene durch

• Als technische Ressource entwickeln, definieren und dokumentieren Sie Standardmethoden, die Sie mit internen Teams teilen können.

• Unterstützung von Forschungs- und Entwicklungsaktivitäten und Beteiligung an POCs/POVs für zukünftige Verbesserungen

Was wir sehen müssen:

• Ein Abschluss in Informatik, Ingenieurwissenschaften oder einem verwandten Bereich und 8+ Jahre Erfahrung

• Kenntnisse der HPC- und KI-Lösungstechnologien von CPUs und GPUs bis hin zu Hochgeschwindigkeitsverbindungen und unterstützender Software

• Erfahrung mit Workloads und Orchestrierungstools wie Slurm, K8s

• Ausgezeichnete Kenntnisse der Windows- und Linux-Netzwerke (Redhat / CentOS und Ubuntu) (Sockets, Firewalld, IPtables, Wireshark usw.) und Interna, ACLs und OS-Sicherheitsschutz und gängige Protokolle wie TCP, DHCP, DNS usw.

• Erfahrung mit verschiedenen Speicherlösungen wie Lustre, GPFS, Weka.io. Vertrautheit mit neueren und aufkommenden Speichertechnologien.

• Python-Programmierung und Bash-Scripting-Erfahrung.

• Komfortabel mit Automatisierungs- und Konfigurationsmanagement-Tools wie Jenkins, Ansible, Puppet/Chef

• Tiefes Wissen über Netzwerkprotokolle wie InfiniBand, Ethernet

• Tiefes Verständnis und Erfahrung mit virtuellen Systemen (zum Beispiel VMware, Hyper-V, KVM oder Citrix)

• Vertrautheit mit Cloud-Computing-Plattformen (z.B. AWS, Azure, Google Cloud)

Möglichkeiten, sich von der Masse abzuheben:

• Kenntnisse der CPU- und/oder GPU-Architektur

• Wissen über Kubernetes, Container-bezogene Microservice-Technologien

• Erfahrung mit GPU-fokussierter Hardware/Software (DGX, Cuda)

• Erfahrung mit RDMA (InfiniBand oder RoCE) Stoffen

• Déployer des solutions de surveillance pour les serveurs, le réseau et le stockage

• Effectuer des dépannages bas vers le haut de métal nu, système d'exploitation, pile de logiciel et niveau d'application

• Être une ressource technique, élaborer, redéfinir et documenter des méthodologies normalisées à partager avec les équipes internes

• Appuyer les activités de recherche et de développement et s'engager dans les PV/PV pour des améliorations futures

Ce que nous devons voir :

• Diplôme en informatique, en génie ou dans un domaine connexe et 8+ ans d'expérience

• Connaissance des technologies de solutions HPC et AI des processeurs et des processeurs à haute vitesse et des logiciels de support

• Expérience des charges de travail et des outils d'orchestration tels que Slurm, K8s

• Excellente connaissance des réseaux Windows et Linux (Redhat/CentOS et Ubuntu) (sockets, pare-feu, iptables, wireshark, etc.) et internes, ACLs et OS niveau sécurité protection et protocoles communs, par exemple TCP, DHCP, DNS, etc.

• Expérience avec plusieurs solutions de stockage telles que Lustre, GPFS, Weka.io. Connaissance des nouvelles technologies de stockage.

• Python programmation et expérience de script bash.

• Confortable avec des outils d'automatisation et de gestion de configuration tels que Jenkins, Ansible, Puppet/chef

• Connaissance approfondie des protocoles de réseautage comme InfiniBand, Ethernet

• Compréhension approfondie et expérience avec les systèmes virtuels (par exemple VMware, Hyper-V, KVM ou Citrix)

• Familiarité avec les plateformes de calcul en nuage (par exemple AWS, Azure, Google Cloud)

Comment se démarquer de la foule :

• Connaissance de l'architecture CPU et/ou GPU

• Connaissance de Kubernetes, technologies de microservice liées aux conteneurs

• Expérience avec le matériel/logiciel orienté GPU (DGX, Cuda)

• Expérience des tissus RDMA (InfiniBand ou RoCE)

Nous sommes un employeur à chances égales et valorisons la diversité dans notre entreprise. Nous ne faisons aucune discrimination fondée sur la race, la religion, la couleur, l'origine nationale, le sexe, le sexe, l'expression du sexe, l'orientation sexuelle, l'âge, l'état matrimonial, le statut d'ancien combattant ou le statut d'invalidité. Nous veillerons à ce que les personnes handicapées bénéficient d'un aménagement raisonnable pour participer au processus de demande d'emploi ou d'entrevue, pour remplir des fonctions essentielles et pour recevoir d'autres avantages et privilèges d'emploi. jobs.title: Senior HPC Performance Engineer
jobs.description:
NVIDIA is leading the way in groundbreaking developments in Artificial Intelligence, High Performance Computing and Visualization. The GPU, our invention, serves as the visual cortex of modern computers and is at the heart of our products and services. Our work opens up new universes to explore, enables amazing creativity and discovery, and powers what were once science fiction inventions from artificial intelligence to autonomous cars.

Come work for the team that brought to you NCCL, NVSHMEM & GPUDirect. Our GPU communication libraries are crucial for scaling Deep Learning and HPC applications! We are looking for a motivated Performance engineer to influence the roadmap of our communication libraries. The DL and HPC applications of today have a huge compute demand and run on scales which go up to tens of thousands of GPUs. The GPUs are connected with high-speed interconnects (eg. NVLink, PCIe) within a node and with high-speed networking (eg. Infiniband, Ethernet) across the nodes. Communication performance between the GPUs has a direct impact on the end-to-end application performance; and the stakes are even higher at huge scales! This is an outstanding opportunity for someone with HPC and performance background to advance the state of the art in this space. Are you ready for to contribute to the development of innovative technologies and help realize NVIDIA's vision?

What you will be doing:

• Conduct in-depth performance characterization and analysis on large multi-GPU and multi-node clusters.

• Study the interaction of our libraries with all HW (GPU, CPU, Networking) and SW components in the stack

• Evaluate proof-of-concepts, conduct trade-off analysis when multiple solutions are available

• Triage and root-cause performance issues reported by our customers

• Collect a lot of performance data; build tools and infrastructure to visualize and analyze the information

• Collaborate with a very dynamic team across multiple time zones

What we need to see:

• M.S. (or equivalent experience) or PHD in Computer Science, or related field with relevant performance engineering and HPC experience

• 3+ yrs of experience with parallel programming and at least one communication runtime (MPI, NCCL, UCX, NVSHMEM)

• Experience conducting performance benchmarking and triage on large scale HPC clusters

• Good understanding of computer system architecture, HW-SW interactions and operating systems principles (aka systems software fundamentals)

• Implement micro-benchmarks in C/C++, read and modify the code base when required

• Ability to debug performance issues across the entire HW/SW stack. Proficient in a scripting language, preferably Python

• Familiar with containers, cloud provisioning and scheduling tools (Kubernetes, SLURM, Ansible, Docker)

• Adaptability and passion to learn new areas and tools. Flexibility to work and communicate effectively across different teams and timezones

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

• Practical experience with Infiniband/Ethernet networks in areas like RDMA, topologies, congestion control

• Experience debugging network issues in large scale deployments

• Familiarity with CUDA programming and/or GPUs

• Experience with Deep Learning Frameworks such PyTorch, TensorFlow

NVIDIA is at the forefront of breakthroughs in Artificial Intelligence, High-Performance Computing, and Visualization. Our teams are composed of driven, innovative professionals dedicated to pushing the boundaries of technology. We offer highly competitive salaries, an extensive benefits package, and a work environment that promotes diversity, inclusion, and flexibility. As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to fostering a supportive and empowering workplace for all.

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. For Poland: The base salary range is 221,250 PLN - 383,500 PLN for Level 3, and 292,500 PLN - 507,000 PLN for Level

descriptionByLocale.it:
NVIDIA sta conducendo la strada negli sviluppi innovativi in intelligenza artificiale, calcolo ad alte prestazioni e visualizzazione. La GPU, la nostra invenzione, funge da corteccia visiva dei computer moderni ed è al centro dei nostri prodotti e servizi. Il nostro lavoro apre nuovi universi per esplorare, permette la creatività incredibile e la scoperta, e poteri che una volta erano invenzioni di fantascienza dall'intelligenza artificiale alle auto auto autonome. Vieni a lavorare per la squadra che ti ha portato NCCL, NVSHMEM & GPUDirect. Le nostre librerie di comunicazione GPU sono cruciali per scalare le applicazioni Deep Learning e HPC! Stiamo cercando un ingegnere di performance motivato per influenzare la roadmap delle nostre librerie di comunicazione. Le applicazioni DL e HPC di oggi hanno una grande domanda di calcolo e funzionano su scale che vanno fino a decine di migliaia di GPU. Le GPU sono collegate con interconnessioni ad alta velocità (ad esempio NVLink, PCIe) all'interno di un nodo e con reti ad alta velocità (ad esempio Infiniband, Ethernet) attraverso i nodi. Le prestazioni di comunicazione tra le GPU hanno un impatto diretto sulle prestazioni dell'applicazione end-to-end; e la posta in gioco è ancora più alta a grandi scale! Questa è un'opportunità eccezionale per qualcuno con HPC e background performance per far progredire lo stato dell'arte in questo spazio. Siete pronti a contribuire allo sviluppo di tecnologie innovative e contribuire a realizzare la visione di NVIDIA? Cosa farai:
• Condurre in profondità la caratterizzazione e l'analisi delle prestazioni su grandi cluster multi-GPU e multi-nodi.
• Studiare l'interazione delle nostre librerie con tutti i componenti HW (GPU, CPU, Networking) e SW nello stack
• Valutare la prova di concetti, condurre analisi di trade-off quando sono disponibili più soluzioni
• Triage e root-cause problemi di prestazioni segnalati dai nostri clienti
• Raccogliere un sacco di dati sulle prestazioni; costruire strumenti e infrastrutture per visualizzare e analizzare le informazioni
• Collabora con un team molto dinamico in più fusi orari Cosa dobbiamo vedere:
• M.S. (o esperienza equivalente) o PHD in Informatica, o campo correlato con l'ingegneria delle prestazioni rilevanti e l'esperienza HPC
• 3+ anni di esperienza con programmazione parallela e almeno un runtime di comunicazione (MPI, NCCL, UCX, NVSHMEM)
• Esperienza di condurre benchmarking delle prestazioni e triage su cluster HPC su larga scala
• Buona comprensione dell'architettura del sistema informatico, delle interazioni HW-SW e dei principi dei sistemi operativi (aka systems software fondamentalis)
• Implementare micro-benchmarks in C/C++, leggere e modificare la base di codice quando necessario
• Capacità di debug problemi di prestazioni in tutto lo stack HW/SW. Proficiente in una lingua di scrittura, preferibilmente Python
• Familiare con contenitori, cloud provisioning e strumenti di programmazione (Kubernetes, SLURM, Ansible, Docker)
• Adattabilità e passione per imparare nuove aree e strumenti. Flessibilità di lavorare e comunicare efficacemente in diverse squadre e fusi orari Modi per distinguersi dalla folla:
• Esperienza pratica con reti Infiniband/Ethernet in aree come RDMA, topologie, controllo della congestione
• Esperienza di debugging problemi di rete in distribuzioni su larga scala
• Familiarità con programmazione CUDA e/o GPU
• Esperienza con Deep Learning Frameworks come PyTorch, TensorFlow NVIDIA è all'avanguardia delle scoperte nell'Intelligenza Artificiale, nell'High-Performance Computing e nella Visualizzazione. I nostri team sono composti da professionisti guidati e innovativi dedicati a spingere i confini della tecnologia. Offriamo stipendi altamente competitivi, un pacchetto di benefici e un ambiente di lavoro che promuove la diversità, l'inclusione e la flessibilità. Come datore di lavoro pari opportunità, ci impegniamo a promuovere un posto di lavoro di supporto e di potenziamento per tutti. Il tuo stipendio base sarà determinato in base alla tua posizione, esperienza e la paga dei dipendenti in posizioni simili. Per la Polonia: la gamma di stipendio base è 221,250 PLN - 383,500 PLN per il livello 3, e 292,500 PLN - 507,000 PLN per il livello

jobs.title: Senior Software Solutions Engineer
jobs.description:
NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people on the planet working for us. If you're creative, passionate, and self-motivated, we want to hear from you! We are looking for an experienced networking software engineer. An awesome candidate is highly technical who is also comfortable with dealing with enterprise customers. You will join a team of Solution Engineers focused on the Mellanox Networking, DGX Platforms, Container Orchestrators, Deep Learning containers, and other Enterprise related system software.
  SW Solution Engineers spend approximately 50% of their time helping customers with their most complex problems and 50% of their time doing R&D related work. This individual should have proven grasp of datacenter and networking technologies, to provide comprehensive solutions for complex installations, maintenance, or operations for a broad scope of leading-edge networking products.

What you'll be doing:

• Take ownership and drive customer issues with Ethernet or InfiniBand network adapter/DPU deployments from inception to resolution.

• Develop features and tools as part of solution engineering efforts to support all Enterprise Service offerings including but not limited to Networking products.

• Work with NVIDIA Enterprise customers and internal users to improve the availability, reliability, and overall experience of working with NVIDIA Networking products.

• Bring independent analysis, communication, and problem-solving to customer experience.

• Collaborate with engineering to document, recreate and solve issues.

What we need to see:

• BSc in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).

• 8+ years system software development and troubleshooting experience, ideally with some customer facing.

• Experience developing with C/C++ in kernel and/or application space and/or embedded software.

• Strong understanding of GNU/Linux (tools, utilities, kernel, networking stack) and Linux-based virtualization (namespaces, containers, K8s)

• Intellectual curiosity, positive attitude, flexibility, analytical ability, self-motivation, and team orientation.

• Professional-level communication skills, interpersonal skills with a passion to solve problems.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

• Familiarity with InfiniBand networks, RDMA protocol, RoCE, DPUs, DPDK, HPC applications (MPI/UCX), OVS

• Hands-on experience in troubleshooting and analysis of the common datacenter networking protocols/technologies (e.g.: LACP, OSPF, BGP, EVPN, VXLAN)

• Proven ability to deeply analyze IP / Layer 2 switching / Layer 3 routing networking protocols (ARP, STP, LACP, MLAG, IGMP, PIM, BGP, OSPF).

• Contributions to networking related open-source projects.

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. For Poland: The base salary range is 230,250 PLN - 399,100 PLN for Level 4, and 281,250 PLN - 487,500 PLN for Level 5.

jobs.title: Senior HPC Performance Engineer
jobs.description:
As a member of our team in NVIDIA's NVHPC compilers & tools group, you will analyze and run High Performance Computing (HPC) applications on HPC servers and systems to gain insight into the performance characteristics of these applications. The applications you'll work with range from small synthetic benchmarks that use a single core to full applications that utilize all of the resources on distributed-memory systems with heterogeneous compute nodes including CPUs, GPUs and many-core processors. In this role you will analyze these applications and identify optimization opportunities for compiler development teams and application engineering teams.

What you’ll be doing:

• Assist customers GPU accelerate HPC applications.

• Analyze High Performance Computing(HPC) applications to better understand their performance characteristics.

• Provide advise and drive compiler and applications engineering development teams based on the analysis of these HPC applications.

• Solid understanding of Fortran/C/C++, as well as programming techniques, especially for parallel architectures; preferably for compilers

• Strong skills in performance analysis and tuning, as well as a broad understanding of parallel applications development tools and runtime environments.

• Bereitstellung von Beratungs- und Entwicklungsteams für Compiler und Applications Engineering auf der Grundlage der Analyse dieser HPC-Anwendungen.

Was wir sehen müssen:

• BS / MS oder gleichwertige Erfahrung in Informatik oder verwandten Engineering-Bereich.

• 8+ Jahre Programmiererfahrung.

• Solides Verständnis von Fortran/C/C++ sowie Programmiertechniken, insbesondere für parallele Architekturen; vorzugsweise für Compiler

descriptionByLocale.fr:
En tant que membre de notre équipe du groupe de compilateurs et outils NVHPC de NVIDIA, vous analyserez et exécuterez des applications de calcul haute performance (HPC) sur les serveurs et systèmes HPC pour mieux comprendre les caractéristiques de performance de ces applications. Les applications avec lesquelles vous travaillerez vont de petits benchmarks synthétiques qui utilisent un seul noyau à des applications complètes qui utilisent toutes les ressources sur les systèmes à mémoire distribuée avec des nœuds de calcul hétérogènes, y compris les processeurs CPU, GPU et plusieurs processeurs de cœur. Dans ce rôle, vous analyserez ces applications et identifierez les possibilités d'optimisation pour les équipes de développement des compilateurs et les équipes d'ingénierie des applications.

Ce que vous allez faire:

• Aider les clients GPU accélérer les applications HPC.

• Analysez les applications de calcul haute performance (HPC) pour mieux comprendre leurs caractéristiques de performance.

• Fournir des conseils et conduire compilateur et des équipes de développement d'applications d'ingénierie basé sur l'analyse de ces applications HPC.

Ce que nous devons voir :

• BS/MS ou expérience équivalente en informatique ou en génie connexe.

• 8 ans et plus d'expérience en programmation.

• Une bonne compréhension de Fortran/C/C++ ainsi que des techniques de programmation, en particulier pour les architectures parallèles; de préférence pour les compilateurs

• Expérience avec OpenACC, OpenMP, MPI et CUDA.

• De solides compétences en analyse de performance et en réglage, ainsi qu'une compréhension large des outils de développement d'applications parallèles et des environnements d'exécution.

• Forts fondamentaux mathématiques, y compris l'algèbre linéaire et les méthodes numériques.

• Comprendre les facteurs de rendement, les compromis et l'impact.

• Compétences interpersonnelles expertes, approche logique de la résolution de problèmes, bonne gestion du temps et compétences en priorisation des tâches. Excellente capacité de communication écrite et verbale.

• De solides compétences en communication sont requises ainsi que la capacité de travailler dans une équipe dynamique axée sur les produits.

• L'expérience est la direction et/ou la gestion des projets est un atout.

Des façons de se démarquer de la foule :

• Vous avez une compréhension profonde des architectures de machines et des micro-architectures.

• L'expérience du débogage et du portage ainsi que de la programmation en langage d'assemblage est un avantage important.

NVIDIA est largement considéré comme l'un des employeurs les plus souhaitables dans le monde de la technologie avec des salaires compétitifs et un ensemble de prestations généreuses.
